title.zh: 卷四百九十四 列傳第二百五十三 蠻夷二 西南溪峒諸蠻下 梅山峒 誠徽州 南丹州
title.en: Volume 494 Biographies 253: Man People 2 - Man People from Xidong in the Southwest 2
title.raw: 卷四百九十四 列傳第二百五十三 蠻夷二 西南溪峒諸蠻下 梅山峒 誠徽州 南丹州 Volume 494 Biographies 253: Man People 2 - Man People from Xidong in the Southwest 2

sentences.zh: 西南溪峒諸蠻下 梅山峒 誠徽州 南丹州

translations.literal: Southwestern stream-cave tribes, lower section; Meishan Dong; Chenghui Prefecture; Nandan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Southwestern Stream-cave Tribes (continued): Meishan Dong, Chenghui Prefecture, and Nandan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西南溪峒諸蠻下

translations.literal: Southwestern stream-cave tribes, lower section.
translations.idiomatic: Southwestern Stream-cave Tribes (continued)

sentences.zh: 紹興三年，臣僚言：“武岡軍溪峒舊嚐集人戶為義保，蓋其風土、習俗、服食、器械悉同徭人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxing, a court official said: "The stream-cave districts of Wugang Prefecture formerly gathered households into Righteous Guards, for their climate, customs, diet, dress, and weapons were all the same as those of the Yao."
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Shaoxing (1133), a memorialist reported: "The stream-cave communities of Wugang Prefecture once enrolled households as Righteous Guards—their environment, customs, food, clothing, and arms were indistinguishable from the Yao."

sentences.zh: 故可為疆場捍蔽，雖曰籍之於官，然亦未嚐遠戍。

translations.literal: Therefore they could serve as a frontier shield; although they were registered with the government, they had never been sent on distant garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: They could thus shield the borderlands; though registered with the state, they were never posted to distant garrisons.

sentences.zh: 靖康間，調之以勤王，其後湖南盜起，征斂百出，義保無復舊制，困苦不勝，乃舉其世業，客依蠻峒，聽其繇役。

translations.literal: During the Jingkang era they were mobilized to aid the throne; afterward bandits rose in Hunan, levies multiplied in every form, the Righteous Guards no longer followed the old system, and unable to bear their hardship they abandoned their hereditary holdings, lodged as guests among the tribal caves, and submitted to corvée there.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jingkang crisis they were called up to rescue the dynasty; later, when Hunan was overrun by bandits and exactions multiplied, the Righteous Guards lost their old organization. Overwhelmed by hardship, they gave up their ancestral estates, took refuge among tribal strongholds, and accepted corvée under tribal masters.

sentences.zh: 州縣猶驗舊籍催科，胥隸及門，則挈家遠徙，官失其稅，蠻獠日強。

translations.literal: The prefectures and counties still checked the old registers to press for taxes; when clerks and runners came to their doors, whole families moved far away, the government lost its revenue, and the tribal peoples grew stronger day by day.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties still used old registers to dun them for taxes; when runners appeared at the door, families fled wholesale. The state lost revenue while the tribes grew stronger by the day.

sentences.zh: 兼武岡所屬三縣，悉為徭人所有，遠戍之實已無，而鄉戶弩手之名尚在，歲取其直，人戶谘怨。

translations.literal: Moreover, the three counties subordinate to Wugang had all fallen into Yao possession; the reality of distant garrison service was already gone, yet the name of village crossbowmen still remained and their annual stipend was still collected, to the grievance of the households.
translations.idiomatic: All three counties under Wugang had passed into Yao hands; distant garrison duty existed in name only, yet village crossbowmen were still listed and their annual pay still collected—households complained bitterly.

sentences.zh: 乞擇本路監司詳議以聞。

translations.literal: He requested that circuit supervisors of this route be chosen to deliberate in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that circuit supervisors be directed to study the matter in detail and report.

sentences.zh: ”詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 四年，辰州言，歸明保靜、南渭、永順三州彭儒武等久欲奉表入貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Chen Prefecture reported that Peng Ruwu and others of the three pacified prefectures Baojing, Nanwei, and Yongshun had long wished to present a memorial and offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year (1134), Chen Prefecture reported that Peng Ruwu and other chiefs of the pacified prefectures Baojing, Nanwei, and Yongshun had long wished to submit memorials and tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔以道路未通，俾荊湖北帥司慰諭，免赴闕。

translations.literal: An edict said that because the roads were not open, the Jinghu North commander was to console and instruct them and exempt them from coming to court.
translations.idiomatic: Because routes were still unsafe, the Jinghu North commander was ordered to reassure them and exempt them from traveling to court.

sentences.zh: 遣人持表及方物赴行在，仍優賜以答之。

translations.literal: They were to send men bearing the memorial and local products to the mobile court, and generous gifts were still to be given in reply.
translations.idiomatic: They might send envoys with memorials and local products to the mobile court, and would receive generous gifts in return.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔荊湖南、北路溪峒頭首土人及主管年滿人合給恩賜，俾各路帥司會計覆實以聞。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, an edict ordered that stream-cave headmen and native supervisors in Jinghu South and North whose terms had expired should receive imperial favors, and that each route commander was to tally and verify the accounts and report.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, headmen and native supervisors in Jinghu South and North whose terms had expired were ordered imperial rewards; route commanders were to verify accounts and report.

sentences.zh: 六年，知鼎州張觷言：“鼎、澧、辰、沅、靖州與溪峒接壤，祖宗時嚐置弓弩手，得其死力，比緣多故，遂皆廢闕。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Zhang Jue, prefect of Ding Prefecture, said: "Ding, Li, Chen, Yuan, and Jing prefectures border the stream-caves; in the time of the ancestors crossbowmen were once posted and gave their utmost loyalty, but because of many troubles they have all been abolished."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1136), Zhang Jue, prefect of Ding, memorialized: "Ding, Li, Chen, Yuan, and Jing border the stream-caves. Former emperors posted crossbowmen who served with utter loyalty, but successive crises have abolished the system."

sentences.zh: 萬一蠻夷生變，將誰與捍禦？

translations.literal: If the tribes should rise in revolt, with whom will we defend?
translations.idiomatic: If the tribes rebel, who will defend the frontier?

sentences.zh: 今雖各出良田，募人以補其額，率皆豪強遣僮奴竄名籍中，乘時射利，無益公家，所宜汰去。

translations.literal: Although good fields are now offered everywhere to recruit men to fill the quotas, for the most part powerful families send slave boys to slip into the registers, seize profit in opportune seasons, and bring no benefit to the state—these should be eliminated.
translations.idiomatic: Good land is offered to fill quotas, but powerful families usually plant bondsmen in the rolls to profit at opportune moments—this helps the state not at all and should be purged.

sentences.zh: 則募溪峒司兵得三百人，俾加習練，足為守禦，給田募人開墾，以供軍儲。

translations.literal: Then recruit three hundred stream-cave militiamen, have them drilled, sufficient for defense, grant fields and recruit settlers to open land, and supply military stores.
translations.idiomatic: Recruit three hundred stream-cave militiamen, drill them for defense, and grant land to settlers to open fields for military stores.

sentences.zh: ”詔荊湖北路帥司相度以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Jinghu North commander to deliberate and report.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinghu North commander was ordered to study the proposal and report.

sentences.zh: 帥司言：“營田四州舊置弓弩手九千一百一十人，練習武事，散居邊境，鎮撫蠻夷，平居則事耕作，緩急以備戰守，深為利便。

translations.literal: The commander said: "In the four garrison-field prefectures there were formerly 9,110 crossbowmen who practiced martial affairs, were scattered along the border, pacified the tribes, farmed in peacetime, and stood ready in emergencies for war and defense—this was deeply advantageous."
translations.idiomatic: The commander replied: "The four garrison-field prefectures once fielded 9,110 crossbowmen trained for war, scattered along the border to pacify tribes. They farmed in peace and fought in crisis—a deeply effective arrangement."

sentences.zh: 靖康初，調發應援河東，全軍陷沒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingkang they were mobilized to reinforce Hedong and the whole force was lost.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Jingkang crisis they were sent to reinforce Hedong and the entire force was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 今辰、沅、澧、靖等州乏兵防守，竊慮蠻夷生變叵測。

translations.literal: Now Chen, Yuan, Li, Jing, and other prefectures lack troops for defense, and I privately fear an unpredictable tribal uprising.
translations.idiomatic: Chen, Yuan, Li, and Jing now lack troops for defense; I fear an unpredictable tribal revolt.

sentences.zh: 若將四州弓弩手減元額，定為三千五百人，辰州置千人，沅州置千五百人，澧州、靖州各置五百人，分處要害，量給土田，訓練以時，耕戰合度，庶可備禦。

translations.literal: If the crossbowmen of the four prefectures are reduced from the original quota and fixed at 3,500—1,000 at Chen, 1,500 at Yuan, 500 each at Li and Jing—posted at key points, granted land in due measure, trained on schedule, and balanced between farming and fighting, defense may be secured.
translations.idiomatic: Reduce the four-prefecture crossbowmen from the old quota to 3,500—1,000 at Chen, 1,500 at Yuan, 500 each at Li and Jing—posted at key points with measured land grants, timely training, and balanced farming and fighting, and defense should hold.

sentences.zh: 以所餘閑田募人耕作，歲收其租，其於邊防財賦，兩得其便，可為經久之計。

translations.literal: With the remaining idle fields recruit cultivators, collect annual rent, and both frontier defense and revenue will benefit—a plan for the long term.
translations.idiomatic: Recruit farmers for remaining idle land, collect rent annually, and both frontier defense and revenue will benefit—a lasting plan.

sentences.zh: ”詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 七年六月，張觷言：“湖外自靖康以來，盜賊盤踞，鍾相、楊太山、雷德進等相繼叛，澧州所屬尤甚。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year, Zhang Jue said: "Beyond the lakes, since Jingkang bandits have held sway; Zhong Xiang, Yang Taishan, Lei Dejin, and others rebelled in succession, especially in the districts of Li Prefecture."
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year (1137), Zhang Jue reported: "Since Jingkang, bandits have held the lake country—Zhong Xiang, Yang Taishan, Lei Dejin, and others rebelled in turn, especially in Li Prefecture."

sentences.zh: 獨慈利縣向思勝等五人素號溪峒歸明，誓掌防拓，卒能保境息民，使德進賊黨無所剽掠，思勝後竟殺德進。

translations.literal: Only Xiang Sisheng and four others of Cili County were known as stream-cave subjects who had submitted; they vowed to guard the frontier, finally kept the territory secure and the people at peace, denied Lei Dejin's band any plunder, and Sisheng later killed Dejin.
translations.idiomatic: Only Xiang Sisheng and four others of Cili, long known as pacified stream-cave leaders, vowed to guard the frontier. They kept the district secure, denied Lei Dejin's band any loot, and Sisheng eventually killed Dejin.

sentences.zh: 會官軍招撫劉智等，而彭永健、彭永政、彭永全、彭永勝及思勝共獻糧助官軍，招復諸山四十餘柵，宣力效忠功居多，宜加恩賞。

translations.literal: When government troops pacified Liu Zhi and others, Peng Yongjian, Peng Yongzheng, Peng Yongquan, Peng Yongsheng, and Sisheng together supplied grain to aid the army, recovered more than forty mountain stockades, and exerted loyal service—their merit was great and rewards should be increased.
translations.idiomatic: When government troops pacified Liu Zhi and others, Peng Yongjian, Peng Yongzheng, Peng Yongquan, Peng Yongsheng, and Sisheng supplied grain, recovered more than forty mountain stockades, and served loyally—they deserved enhanced rewards.

sentences.zh: ”詔思勝等五人各轉兩資。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Sisheng and the other five each advance two ranks in salary grade.
translations.idiomatic: Sisheng and the other four were each advanced two salary grades.

sentences.zh: 九月，詔荊湖、廣南路溪峒頭首土人內有子孫應襲職名差遣，及主管年滿合給恩賜之數，俾帥司取會核實以聞。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, an edict ordered that among stream-cave headmen and native supervisors in Jinghu and Guangnan circuits, those with descendants who should inherit offices and assignments, and those whose terms had expired and who should receive favors, were to be tallied and verified by the commanders and reported.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Jinghu and Guangnan commanders were ordered to verify headmen and native supervisors due for hereditary succession or end-of-term rewards and report.

sentences.zh: 九年，宜章峒民駱科作亂，寇郴、道、連、桂陽諸州縣，詔發大兵往討之，獲駱科。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the cave-dweller Luo Ke of Yizhang rebelled, raided Chen, Dao, Lian, and Guiyang prefectures and counties, and an edict sent a large force to attack; Luo Ke was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year (1139), Luo Ke of the Yizhang caves rebelled and raided Chen, Dao, Lian, and Guiyang. A large force was dispatched; Luo Ke was captured.

sentences.zh: 餘黨歐幼四等復叛，據藍山，寇平陽縣，遣江西兵馬都監程師回討平之。

translations.literal: The remnant Ou Yousi and others rebelled again, seized Lanshan, raided Pingyang County, and the Jiangxi military supervisor Cheng Shihui was sent to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Remnants led by Ou Yousi rebelled again, seized Lanshan, and raided Pingyang. Jiangxi military supervisor Cheng Shihui was sent and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 十年，承信郎琴州溪峒楊進顒等率族屬歸生界五百餘戶、疆土三百餘里，獻累世所造兵器及金爐、酒杯各一，求入覲，詔本路帥司敦遣以行。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Yang Jinyang and others of the Qin Prefecture stream-caves, as Bearer of Faithful Trust, led their clans to submit more than 500 households and 300 li of territory, presented weapons made over generations and one each of a gold censer and wine cup, and sought audience; an edict ordered the route commander to urge them on their way.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1140), Yang Jinyang of the Qin Prefecture stream-caves led his clan to submit more than 500 households and 300 li of territory, presented heirloom weapons plus a gold censer and wine cup, and sought audience. The route commander was ordered to escort them promptly.

sentences.zh: 十二年，詔以施州南砦路夷人向再健襲父思遷充銀青光祿大夫、檢校國子祭酒兼監察御史、武騎尉、知懿州事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, an edict appointed Xiang Zaijian of the Nanzhai route Yi of Shi Prefecture to succeed his father Sixian as Silver-Gleam Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, acting Director of the Imperial Academy and concurrent Investigating Censor, Martial Cavalry Commandant, and Administrator of Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year (1142), Xiang Zaijian of the Shi Prefecture Nanzhai Yi succeeded his father Sixian as Silver-Gleam Grand Master, acting Director of the Imperial Academy and Investigating Censor, Martial Cavalry Commandant, and prefect of Yi.

sentences.zh: 十四年十月，湖南安撫使劉昉奏，武岡軍徭人有父子相殺者，宜出兵助其父，俾還省地。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourteenth year, Hunan pacification commissioner Liu Fang memorialized that among the Yao of Wugang Prefecture a father and son had killed each other; troops should aid the father and make him restore the provincial territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourteenth year (1144), Hunan pacification commissioner Liu Fang reported a father-son killing among Wugang Yao and urged troops to aid the father and recover provincial land.

sentences.zh: 上以問輔臣秦檜，檜曰：“恐輕舉生事。

translations.literal: The emperor asked Grand Councilor Qin Hui, who said: "I fear a rash move would stir trouble."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked Grand Councilor Qin Hui, who said, "A rash move might stir trouble."

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“恩威不可偏廢，可懷則示之以恩，否則威之。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Favor and awe must not be abandoned on one side; where they can be won over, show favor; otherwise show awe."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied, "Favor and awe must both be used—win them with kindness where possible, with force where not."

sentences.zh: 不侵省地則已，或有所侵，奈何不舉，俾知所畏哉。

translations.literal: "If they do not encroach on provincial land, very well; but if they encroach, how can we not act and let them know what to fear?"
translations.idiomatic: "If they keep off provincial land, fine—but if they encroach, how can we stand idle? They must learn fear."

sentences.zh: ”十二月，成忠郎充武岡軍綏寧縣管界都巡檢兼溪峒首領楊進京，率其族三百人，備黃金、朱砂、方物求入貢，先遣其子孝友陳請。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Yang Jinjing, Loyal and Faithful Gentleman, frontier inspector of Suining County in Wugang Prefecture and stream-cave headman, led three hundred of his clan with gold, cinnabar, and local products seeking to offer tribute, and first sent his son Xiaoyou to petition.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Yang Jinjing—Loyal and Faithful Gentleman, Suining frontier inspector and stream-cave headman—led three hundred clansmen with gold, cinnabar, and tribute goods, sending his son Xiaoyou ahead to petition.

sentences.zh: 詔本路帥司閱舊制以聞，給孝友錢三百貫，俾還聽進止。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the route commander to review the old regulations and report, gave Xiaoyou three hundred strings of cash, and sent him back to await further orders.
translations.idiomatic: The route commander was told to review old regulations and report; Xiaoyou received three hundred strings of cash and was sent home pending further orders.

sentences.zh: 十五年，楊進顒復求入貢，以武岡軍不時敦遣為言。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Yang Jinyang again sought to offer tribute, saying that Wugang Prefecture had not promptly urged him on his way.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1145), Yang Jinyang again sought tribute, complaining that Wugang had not escorted him promptly.

sentences.zh: 詔本路帥司閱實應襲人姓名來上，並促進顒入覲。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the route commander to verify and submit the names of heirs who should succeed, and to urge Jinyang to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: The route commander was ordered to verify heirs due for succession and urge Jinyang to court.

sentences.zh: 四月，廣南東路提刑黃應南言：“溪峒巡檢、尉、砦官不嚴守備，縱民與徭交通，恐啟邊釁，乞詔有司申嚴法令，俾帥臣、監司常加覺察。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Guangnan East circuit judicial intendant Huang Yingnan said: "Stream-cave inspectors, assistants, and fort officers do not strictly guard the posts and allow commoners to trade with the Yao, which may open a border quarrel; I beg an edict to the offices to enforce the laws strictly and have commanders and supervisors constantly watch."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Guangnan East judicial intendant Huang Yingnan warned that stream-cave inspectors and fort officers neglected defense and let civilians trade with Yao, risking border conflict. He asked for stricter laws and constant supervision by commanders.

sentences.zh: ”宰臣以為沿邊互市，恐不宜禁絕。

translations.literal: The councilors held that frontier mutual markets should perhaps not be entirely forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Councilors argued that frontier trade should not be entirely banned.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：“往年禁西夏互市，遂至用兵，可令帥司裁決。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "In former years forbidding trade with Western Xia led to war; let the commanders decide."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Banning trade with Western Xia once led to war—let commanders decide."

sentences.zh: ”前知全州高楫言：“徭人今皆微弱，不敢先侵省地，砦官每縱人深入，略其財物，遂致乘間竊發。

translations.literal: Former prefect of Quan Prefecture Gao Ji said: "The Yao are now all weak and dare not first encroach on provincial land; fort officers often let men go deep in, plunder their goods, and thus incidents break out when chance offers."
translations.idiomatic: Former Quan prefect Gao Ji said, "The Yao are now weak and dare not strike first—but fort officers let men raid deep into their lands, plunder them, and provoke opportunistic outbreaks."

sentences.zh: 宜詔與溪峒接壤州郡毋侵徭人，庶使邊民安業，以廣陛下柔遠好生之德。

translations.literal: An edict should order prefectures bordering the stream-caves not to encroach on the Yao, so that frontier people may live in peace and Your Majesty's virtue of cherishing the distant and loving life may be extended.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures bordering stream-caves should be forbidden to harass the Yao, so frontier people may live in peace and extend Your Majesty's virtue of cherishing the distant.

sentences.zh: ”帝從其言，詔守臣一遵成法，務在撫綏。

translations.literal: The emperor accepted this and ordered defending officials to follow established law and devote themselves to pacification.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed and ordered local officials to follow established law and prioritize pacification.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，禽楊正修及其弟正拱，送理寺獄鞫治，斬之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Yang Zhengxiu and his brother Zhenggong were captured, sent to the Court of Judicial Review for interrogation, and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year (1154), Yang Zhengxiu and his brother Zhenggong were captured, tried at the Court of Judicial Review, and executed.

sentences.zh: 初，正修侍其父再興入覲，獻還省民疆土，遂命以官。

translations.literal: Earlier, Zhengxiu had accompanied his father Zaixing to court, returned provincial territory, and was given office.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Zhengxiu had accompanied his father Zaixing to court, returned seized provincial land, and received an official post.

sentences.zh: 建炎後，與弟正拱率九十團峒徭人出武岡軍，縱火殺掠民財為亂。

translations.literal: After Jianyan he and his brother Zhenggong led ninety regiment-cave Yao out of Wugang Prefecture, set fires, killed, plundered civilian property, and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: After Jianyan he and Zhenggong led ninety regiment-caves of Yao out of Wugang, burning, killing, and looting in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 紹興間，潭州帥司嚐招徠之，後復作亂，屢抗官軍，至是伏誅。

translations.literal: During Shaoxing the Tan Prefecture commander once won them over, but they rebelled again, repeatedly resisted government troops, and now were executed.
translations.idiomatic: During Shaoxing the Tan commander once won them over, but they rebelled again, repeatedly fought government troops, and were finally executed.

sentences.zh: 二十八年七月，楊進京等復求入貢，詔以道遠慰諭之，優其賜與。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twenty-eighth year, Yang Jinjing and others again sought to offer tribute; an edict consoled them because the road was far and gave them generous gifts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-eighth year (1158), Yang Jinjing again sought tribute; the court consoled them on the long journey and gave generous gifts.

sentences.zh: 隆興初，右正言尹穡言：“湖南州縣多鄰溪峒，省民往往交通徭人，擅自易田，豪猾大姓或詐匿其產徭人，以避科差。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longxing, Right Remonstrator Yin Ji said: "Many Hunan prefectures and counties border stream-caves; provincial people often deal with the Yao and privately exchange fields, and powerful clans sometimes falsely register their property under Yao names to evade levies."
translations.idiomatic: Early in Longxing (1163), Right Remonstrator Yin Ji reported that Hunan counties bordering stream-caves saw civilians trading land with Yao and powerful families falsely registering property under Yao names to evade taxes.

sentences.zh: 內虧國賦，外滋邊患。

translations.literal: Within, state revenue is lost; without, border troubles grow.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue was lost within while border troubles grew without.

sentences.zh: 宜詔湖南安撫司表正經界，禁民毋質田徭人。

translations.literal: An edict should order the Hunan pacification office to fix the boundaries and forbid people from mortgaging fields to the Yao.
translations.idiomatic: The Hunan pacification office should fix boundaries and forbid mortgaging land to Yao.

sentences.zh: 詐匿其產徭人者論如法，仍沒入其田，以賞告奸者。

translations.literal: Those who falsely hide property under Yao names should be punished by law, their fields confiscated, and informers rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: False registration under Yao names should be punished, fields confiscated, and informers rewarded.

sentences.zh: 田前賣入徭人，俾為別籍，毋遽奪，能還其田者，縣代給錢嚐之。

translations.literal: Fields already sold to Yao should be placed on a separate register without sudden seizure; those who can recover their fields should be compensated by the county.
translations.idiomatic: Land already sold to Yao should be separately registered without sudden seizure; counties should compensate those who recover their fields.

sentences.zh: ”帝從其言。

translations.literal: The emperor accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 乾道元年，宜章峒賊李金陷郴州，焚桂陽軍，州將棄城遁，衡州調常寧縣兵救之，弗克。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qiandao, the Yizhang cave bandit Li Jin took Chen Prefecture, burned Guiyang Commandery, the prefectural commander abandoned the city and fled, Heng Prefecture mobilized Changning County troops to rescue but failed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qiandao (1165), the Yizhang bandit Li Jin seized Chen Prefecture and burned Guiyang Commandery. The prefectural commander fled; Heng's Changning troops failed to relieve the city.

sentences.zh: 世忠峒李昂霄者，率壯丁禦賊，民恃以安。

translations.literal: Li Angxiao of the Shizhong cave led stalwart men to resist the bandits, and the people relied on him for safety.
translations.idiomatic: Li Angxiao of the Shizhong cave led stalwarts against the bandits, and the people found safety in him.

sentences.zh: 湖南提舉常平鄭丙請發鄂渚軍討賊，平之。

translations.literal: Hunan Ever-Normal intendant Zheng Bing asked to send Ezhou garrison troops to attack the bandits and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan Ever-Normal intendant Zheng Bing requested Ezhou troops, who pacified the rebels.

sentences.zh: 昂霄以功補承節郎，管轄衡州常寧縣溪峒，及官其子當年，俾後得襲職。

translations.literal: Angxiao was appointed Bearer of Merit for his service, placed in charge of the Changning stream-caves in Heng Prefecture, and his son Dangnian was given office so that he might later inherit the post.
translations.idiomatic: Angxiao was made Bearer of Merit and placed over Heng's Changning stream-caves; his son Dangnian received office with right of succession.

sentences.zh: 三年，靖州界徭人姚明教等作亂，詔荊、鄂駐紮明椿選將率精銳千人，會屯戍官合擊之，能立功者有厚賞。

translations.literal: In the third year, the Yao Yao Mingjiao and others on the Jing Prefecture border rebelled; an edict ordered Ming Chun of the Jing-E garrison to choose a general and lead a thousand elite troops, join garrison officers in joint attack on them, and richly reward those who achieved merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year (1167), Yao Mingjiao and others on the Jing border rebelled. Ming Chun of the Jing-E garrison was ordered to lead a thousand elites with local garrison officers to attack them; achievers would be richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 八月，詔平溪峒互市鹽米價，聽民便，毋相抑配，其徭人歲輸身丁米，務平收，無取羨餘及折輸錢，違者論罪。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, an edict ordered fair prices for salt and grain in stream-cave mutual markets, allowed people convenience without forced allocation, required level collection of the Yao annual head-tax rice without surplus or conversion fees, and punished violators.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, stream-cave market prices for salt and grain were ordered fair, trade free of forced allocation, and Yao head-tax rice collected levelly without surcharges—violators punished.

sentences.zh: 十一月，南郊禮成，詔以緣邊溪峒，州縣失於拊循，致懷反側，或逃竄山谷，其在赦恩以前，並加寬宥，能復業者，罪一切置不問，互市如故，悉聽其便，守臣常加撫問。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, after the southern suburban rites, an edict said that along the frontier stream-caves, because prefectures and counties had failed in care, people harbored doubts or fled to mountain valleys; all offenses before the amnesty were pardoned, those who could return to their livelihoods were wholly excused, mutual markets continued as before with full convenience, and defending officials were to console them constantly.
translations.idiomatic: After the southern suburban rites in the eleventh month, frontier stream-cave peoples neglected by local officials who had fled or wavered were pardoned for all pre-amnesty offenses if they returned to livelihood; markets continued freely under constant official care.

sentences.zh: 以稱綏遠之意。

translations.literal: This expressed the intent to pacify the distant.
translations.idiomatic: This expressed the policy of pacifying the frontier.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，詔湖南北、四川、二廣州軍應有溪峒處，務先恩信綏懷，毋弛防閑，毋襲科擾，毋貪功而啟釁。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year, an edict ordered that wherever stream-caves existed in Hunan North and South, Sichuan, and the two Guang circuits, favor and trust should come first in pacification, defense must not slacken, levies must not be oppressive, and merit-seeking must not open quarrels.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year (1168), all stream-cave regions in Hunan, Sichuan, and Guang were told to prioritize trust and pacification, maintain defense, avoid oppressive levies, and not provoke conflict for merit.

sentences.zh: 委各路帥臣、監司常加覺察。

translations.literal: Route commanders and supervisors were entrusted to watch constantly.
translations.idiomatic: Route commanders and supervisors were to monitor constantly.

sentences.zh: 是月，詔禁沿邊奸人毋越逸溪峒，誘致蠻獠侵內地，違者論如律，其不能防閑致越逸者亦罪之。

translations.literal: That month, an edict forbade frontier scoundrels from crossing into stream-caves and inciting tribes to invade the interior; violators were punished by law, and those who failed to prevent crossings were also guilty.
translations.idiomatic: That month, frontier scoundrels were forbidden to cross into stream-caves and incite tribal raids—violators punished, and officials who failed to prevent crossings also guilty.

sentences.zh: 湖廣總領周嗣武言邊事，如二年四月之詔，帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: Huguang chief steward Zhou Siwu spoke on border affairs as in the edict of the fourth month of the second year, and the emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang chief steward Zhou Siwu spoke on border affairs echoing the second-year fourth-month edict; the emperor praised and accepted it.

sentences.zh: 是歲，田彥古死，子忠佐襲職，授銀青光祿大夫、檢校散騎常侍、知溪峒安化州兼監察御史、飛龍騎尉。

translations.literal: That year, Tian Yanggu died; his son Zhongzuo inherited the post and was appointed Silver-Gleam Grand Master, acting Master of Casual Cavaliers, Administrator of the stream-cave Anhua Prefecture and concurrent Investigating Censor, and Soaring Dragon Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tian Yanggu died; his son Zhongzuo succeeded as Silver-Gleam Grand Master, acting Master of Casual Cavaliers, prefect of stream-cave Anhua and Investigating Censor, and Soaring Dragon Cavalry Commandant.

sentences.zh: 六年，盧陽西據獠楊添朝寇邊，知沅州孫叔傑調兵數千討之，敗績，死者十七八。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, the tribal Yang Tianchao of western Luyang raided the border; Sun Shujie, prefect of Yuan, mobilized several thousand troops to attack, was defeated, and seven or eight in ten died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year (1170), the Luyang tribal Yang Tianchao raided the border. Yuan prefect Sun Shujie led several thousand troops, was routed, and lost seven or eight in ten.

sentences.zh: 初，徭人與省戶交爭，殺二人死，叔傑輒出兵破其十三柵，奪還所侵地，於是徭人相結為亂。

translations.literal: Earlier, Yao and provincial households had quarreled and two men were killed; Shujie promptly sent troops, broke thirteen stockades, and recovered encroached land, whereupon the Yao banded together in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yao and provincial households had fought, killing two. Shujie promptly attacked thirteen stockades and recovered land—whereupon the Yao united in revolt.

sentences.zh: 諸司請調常德府城兵三百人，益官兵三千人，合擊討之。

translations.literal: Various offices asked to mobilize three hundred Changde prefectural troops and add three thousand regular troops for joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Offices requested three hundred Changde troops plus three thousand regulars for joint suppression.

sentences.zh: 宰臣虞允文奏曰：“蠻夷為變，皆守臣貪功所致。

translations.literal: Councilor Yu Yunwen memorialized: "Tribal revolts are all caused by defending officials seeking merit."
translations.idiomatic: Councilor Yu Yunwen said, "Tribal revolts stem from officials seeking merit."

sentences.zh: 今徭人仇視守臣，若更去叔傑，量遣官軍，示以兵威，徐與盟誓，自可平定。

translations.literal: "Now the Yao hate the defending official; if Shujie is removed, a measured force is sent to show military might, and oaths are made gradually, the situation can be settled."
translations.idiomatic: "The Yao now hate the local commander. Remove Shujie, send a measured force to show strength, then slowly make oaths—order can be restored."

sentences.zh: ”帝允其奏，俾葉行代叔傑，開示恩信，諭以禍福，遂招降之，邊境悉平。

translations.literal: The emperor approved; Ye Xing replaced Shujie, showed favor and trust, instructed them on fortune and disaster, and thus won their surrender until the border was wholly pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed. Ye Xing replaced Shujie, showed favor and explained consequences, won their surrender, and pacified the border.

sentences.zh: 前知武岡軍趙善穀言：“武岡與湖北、廣西鄰壤，為極邊之地，溪峒七百八十餘所，七峒隸綏寧縣，五溪峒隸臨岡縣。

translations.literal: Former Wugang prefect Zhao Shangu said: "Wugang borders Hubei and Guangxi and is an extreme frontier; there are more than 780 stream-caves—seven caves under Suining County and five stream-caves under Lingang County."
translations.idiomatic: Former Wugang prefect Zhao Shangu said, "Wugang borders Hubei and Guangxi at the extreme frontier—more than 780 stream-caves, seven under Suining and five under Lingang."

sentences.zh: 紹興三十年，減冗員，改縣為臨口砦。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year of Shaoxing redundant posts were cut and the county was changed to Linkou Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year of Shaoxing (1160) redundant posts were cut and the county became Linkou Fort.

sentences.zh: 然五峒之徭俗尤獷悍，釁生毫髮，則操戈相仇，砦官不能為輕重。

translations.literal: Yet the customs of the five-cave Yao were especially fierce; at the slightest provocation they took up weapons against one another, and fort officers could not weigh in.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the five-cave Yao were especially fierce—at the slightest provocation they took up arms against one another, and fort officers had no leverage.

sentences.zh: 況本軍巡防砦柵，惟真良、三門、兵溪、香平有土軍可備守禦，餘有官無兵，其關硤、武陽等砦設巡檢二員，徒費廩祿。

translations.literal: Moreover, of this commandery's patrol forts and stockades, only Zhenliang, Sanmen, Bingxi, and Xiangping had local troops for defense; the rest had officers but no soldiers; Guanxia, Wuyang, and other forts had two inspectors each, wasting grain salaries in vain.
translations.idiomatic: Of Wugang's patrol forts, only Zhenliang, Sanmen, Bingxi, and Xiangping had local troops; others had officers but no men. Guanxia and Wuyang each had two inspectors wasting salaries.

sentences.zh: 以臣所知，宜復臨口砦為縣，則徭蠻易於製服，汰去冗員，則官廩亦無虛費，實邊郡之利也。

translations.literal: In my knowledge, Linkou Fort should be restored as a county, then Yao and tribes would be easier to control; cutting redundant posts would also end empty spending on grain salaries—a real benefit to the frontier commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Restore Linkou Fort as a county to control Yao and tribes more easily; cut redundant posts to end wasted salaries—a real frontier benefit.

sentences.zh: 七年，前知辰州章才邵上言：“辰之諸蠻與羈縻保靜、南渭、永順三州接壤，其蠻酋歲貢溪布，利於回賜，頗覺馴伏。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, former Chen prefect Zhang Caishao memorialized: "The tribes of Chen border the pacified prefectures Baojing, Nanwei, and Yongshun; their chiefs yearly offer stream-cloth, profit from return gifts, and are quite tractable."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1171), former Chen prefect Zhang Caishao reported that Chen tribes bordering pacified Baojing, Nanwei, and Yongshun submitted annual stream-cloth tribute, profited from return gifts, and were fairly tractable.

sentences.zh: 盧溪諸蠻以靖康多故，縣無守禦，犵狑乘隙焚劫。

translations.literal: The Luxi tribes, because of the many troubles of Jingkang, had no county defense, and the Gelao seized the chance to burn and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Luxi tribes, undefended after Jingkang troubles, were raided by Gelao who burned and plundered.

sentences.zh: 後徙縣治於沅陵縣之江口，蠻酋田仕羅、龔誌能等遂雄據其地。

translations.literal: Later the county seat was moved to the river mouth in Yuanling County, and tribal chiefs Tian Shiluo, Gong Zhineng, and others then dominated the region.
translations.idiomatic: When the county seat moved to Yuanling's river mouth, chiefs Tian Shiluo and Gong Zhineng dominated the old territory.

sentences.zh: 沅陵之浦口，地平衍膏腴，多水田，頃為徭蠻侵掠，民皆轉徙而田野荒穢。

translations.literal: Pukou in Yuanling was level, fertile, and rich in paddy fields; recently Yao and tribes had raided it, the people had all moved away, and the fields lay waste.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanling's Pukou was level, fertile paddy land—recently raided by Yao and tribes until people fled and fields lay waste.

sentences.zh: 會守倅無遠慮，乃以其田給靖州犵狑楊姓者，俾佃作而課其租，所獲甚微。

translations.literal: The prefect and vice-prefect lacked foresight and gave these fields to the Yang clan Gelao of Jing Prefecture to tenant and collect rent, gaining very little.
translations.idiomatic: Short-sighted officials gave the fields to Jing Gelao of the Yang clan to farm for rent, gaining very little.

sentences.zh: 楊氏專其地將二十年，其地當沅、靖二州水陸之衝，一有蠻隙，則為害不細，臣謂宜預為之備。

translations.literal: The Yang clan has monopolized the land for nearly twenty years; the place stands at the land-and-water junction of Yuan and Jing prefectures—once a tribal incident arises, the harm will not be slight; I say preparations should be made in advance.
translations.idiomatic: The Yang clan has held the land nearly twenty years at the Yuan-Jing land-and-water junction—any tribal incident would do great harm; preparations are needed.

sentences.zh: 靖康前，辰州每歲蒙朝廷賜錢七萬貫，、絹、布共八千一百匹，綿一萬七千兩。

translations.literal: Before Jingkang, Chen Prefecture each year received from the court seventy thousand strings of cash, 8,100 bolts of silk and cloth combined, and seventeen thousand taels of cotton.
translations.idiomatic: Before Jingkang, Chen received seventy thousand strings of cash, 8,100 bolts of silk and cloth, and seventeen thousand taels of cotton annually.

sentences.zh: 是時，本州廂禁軍一千四百餘人，沿邊一十六砦，土兵六百餘人，皆可贍給。

translations.literal: At that time the prefecture's metropolitan garrison had more than 1,400 men, sixteen frontier forts, and more than 600 local troops—all could be supplied.
translations.idiomatic: Then the prefecture's 1,400 metropolitan troops, sixteen frontier forts, and 600 local troops were all adequately supplied.

sentences.zh: 其後中外多故，今歲賜止得一萬二千緡，而本州財復匱乏，無以充召募之費。

translations.literal: Afterward, with many troubles at home and abroad, this year's grant is only twelve thousand strings, while prefectural funds are again depleted and there is nothing for recruitment costs.
translations.idiomatic: After successive crises, this year's grant is only twelve thousand strings while prefectural funds are depleted—nothing remains for recruitment.

sentences.zh: 禁軍止二百一十餘人，諸砦土兵止一百五人，甚至砦官有全無一兵而徒存虛名者，其於邊防豈可不為深慮？

translations.literal: Metropolitan troops number only a little over 210, local troops in the forts only 105; some fort officers have not a single soldier and exist only in name—how can frontier defense not be deeply considered?
translations.idiomatic: Metropolitan troops number barely 210, fort local troops only 105—some forts have officers but no soldiers. How can frontier defense not alarm us?

sentences.zh: 若歲增給民錢一萬，俾本州募強壯禁軍或效用二百人，分屯盧溪等處，以防諸蠻，庶使邊患永消，可免異時調遣之費。

translations.literal: If ten thousand strings are added yearly, the prefecture could recruit two hundred stalwart metropolitan troops or irregulars, post them at Luxi and elsewhere to guard against the tribes, and perhaps end border troubles forever, avoiding future mobilization costs.
translations.idiomatic: Adding ten thousand strings yearly would let Chen recruit two hundred stalwart troops posted at Luxi and elsewhere to guard tribes, end border troubles, and avoid future mobilization costs.

sentences.zh: ”書奏，詔湖北帥臣詳議以聞。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, an edict ordered the Hubei commander to deliberate in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: The Hubei commander was ordered to study the memorial and report.

sentences.zh: 是年，申嚴邊民售田之禁，守令不能奉法者除名，部刺史常加糾察。

translations.literal: That year, the ban on frontier people selling fields was strictly enforced; prefects and magistrates who could not obey were removed from office, and circuit commissioners were to investigate constantly.
translations.idiomatic: That year the ban on frontier land sales to tribes was strictly enforced—noncompliant officials removed, circuit commissioners to investigate.

sentences.zh: 八年，知貴州陳乂上疏言：“臣前知靖州時，居蠻夷腹心，民不服役，田不輸賦，其地似若可棄。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Chen Yi, prefect of Gui Prefecture, memorialized: "When I formerly governed Jing Prefecture, I was in the heart of the tribal lands; the people did not perform corvée and fields paid no tax—the place seemed abandonable."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1172), Gui prefect Chen Yi wrote: "When I governed Jing, I sat in the tribal heartland where people paid no corvée or tax—the place seemed abandonable."

sentences.zh: 然為重湖、二廣保障，實南服之要區也。

translations.literal: Yet it is the bulwark of the great lakes and the two Guang circuits—a vital region of the southern realm.
translations.idiomatic: Yet it is the bulwark of the lake country and the two Guang circuits—a vital southern region.

sentences.zh: 或控製失宜，或金穀不繼，或兵甲少振，蠻獠則乘時竊發，勤勞王師，朝廷當重守臣之選。

translations.literal: If control is improper, funds and grain do not continue, or arms and armor are slightly weak, the tribes seize the moment to strike stealthily, toil the royal army, and the court should weigh the choice of defending officials.
translations.idiomatic: If control fails, funds run short, or arms weaken, tribes strike opportunistically and burden the royal army—the court must choose defending officials carefully.

sentences.zh: 崇寧初戍兵三千人，建炎以來，每於都統司或帥司摘兵二千人，以備屯戍。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongning there were three thousand garrison troops; since Jianyan, two thousand men are each year drawn from the overall command or route command for frontier garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Chongning began with three thousand garrison troops; since Jianyan, two thousand are drawn yearly from overall or route commands for frontier duty.

sentences.zh: 其凶悍者，以州郡不能製，遂慢守臣，反通徭蠻以撓編民。

translations.literal: The fierce and violent among them, because the prefectures and counties could not control them, then treated defending officials with contempt and in turn colluded with Yao tribes to harass registered civilians.
translations.idiomatic: The fiercer troops, finding that prefectures and counties could not restrain them, grew contemptuous of local officials and colluded with Yao tribes to harass registered civilians.

sentences.zh: 州郡非白主帥不敢治，比得報，已晚矣。

translations.literal: The prefectures and counties dared not punish without informing the overall commander; by the time a reply was received, it was already too late.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties would not act without reporting to the overall commander first—by the time approval came, it was too late.

sentences.zh: 故戍兵敢肆其惡，一旦有警，復安能為用？

translations.literal: Therefore the garrison troops dared to unleash their wickedness; once there was an alarm, how could they again be of use?
translations.idiomatic: Thus garrison troops dared their outrages; when crisis struck, how could they be relied upon?

sentences.zh: 臣以為宜聽守臣節製為便。

translations.literal: Your subject considers it expedient to allow defending officials to command and control them.
translations.idiomatic: I believe it would be best to place them under the defending officials' command.

sentences.zh: ”帝嘉其言，復問左右曰：“靖隸湖北，今聞仰給廣西，何也？

translations.literal: The Emperor praised his words and again asked those beside him: "Jing is subordinate to Hubei; now I hear it depends on Guangxi for supplies—why is this?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved and asked his attendants: "Jing falls under Hubei circuit, yet I hear it now relies on Guangxi for supplies—why?"

sentences.zh: ”趙雄對曰：“靖州本溪峒，神宗時創為誠州，元祐間廢，尋復為軍，徽宗朝始改靖州，與桂府為鄰，故令廣西給其金穀之費。

translations.literal: Zhao Xiong replied: "Jing Prefecture was originally a stream-cave region; in Emperor Shenzong's time it was first established as Chen Prefecture, abolished during the Yuanyou era, soon restored as a military prefecture, and in Emperor Huizong's reign renamed Jing Prefecture. It borders the Guangxi administrative region, so Guangxi was ordered to supply its funds and grain."
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Xiong answered: "Jing was originally stream-cave country. Shenzong created Chen Prefecture there; it was abolished under Yuanyou, then restored as a military district and renamed Jing under Huizong. Because it neighbors Guangxi, that circuit was assigned to fund it."

sentences.zh: 近歲漕司匱乏，乃責辦諸州，以故不能如約。

translations.literal: In recent years the transport office has been depleted, and the burden was assigned to the various prefectures; for this reason it could not be fulfilled as agreed.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years the transport commission ran short and pushed costs onto individual prefectures, so supplies no longer arrived on schedule.

sentences.zh: 宜復舊制，俾廣西漕臣如期饋運。

translations.literal: The old system should be restored, so that Guangxi transport officials deliver supplies on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: The old arrangement should be restored so Guangxi transport officials deliver on time.

sentences.zh: 靖州屯戍官兵聽守臣節製，於事為便。

translations.literal: The garrison troops stationed at Jing Prefecture should be placed under defending officials' command; this would be expedient for affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jing's garrison troops should answer to the defending officials—that would serve best.

sentences.zh: ”帝從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 十年四月，全州上言：“本州密邇溪峒，邊民本非奸惡。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the tenth year, Quan Prefecture submitted: "This prefecture borders the stream-caves closely; the frontier people are not wicked by nature."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the tenth year, Quan Prefecture reported: "We lie close to the stream-caves; our frontier people are not inherently wicked."

sentences.zh: 其始，朝廷禁法非不嚴密，監司、州郡非不奉行，特以平居失於防閑，故馴致其亂。

translations.literal: At the beginning, the court's prohibitions were not lacking in strictness, and circuit commissioners and prefectures did not fail to enforce them; it was only that in ordinary times vigilance was neglected, and so disorder was gradually brought about.
translations.idiomatic: At first the court's bans were strict and circuit and prefectural officials enforced them—but routine vigilance lapsed, and disorder followed by degrees.

sentences.zh: 又兼溪穀山徑非止一途，如靜江、興安之大通虛，武岡軍之新寧、盆溪及八十里山，永州之東安，皆可以徑達溪峒。

translations.literal: Moreover, the mountain paths through stream valleys are not limited to one route—such as Datongxu in Jingjiang and Xing'an, Xinning, Penxi, and Eighty-li Mountain in Wugang Prefecture, and Dong'an in Yong Prefecture—all can reach the stream-caves directly.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, mountain paths through the stream valleys are many: Datongxu in Jingjiang and Xing'an; Xinning, Penxi, and Eighty-li Mountain in Wugang; Dong'an in Yong—all lead straight into the stream-caves.

sentences.zh: 其地綿亙郡邑，非一州得專約束，故遊民惡少之棄本者，商旅之避征稅者，盜賊之亡命者，往往由之以入。

translations.literal: The territory stretches across many prefectures and counties, and no single prefecture can exclusively restrain it; therefore vagabonds and wicked youths who abandon their livelihoods, merchants and travelers who evade taxes and levies, and bandits and fugitives often enter by these routes.
translations.idiomatic: The region spans many prefectures, so no single one can control it. Vagabonds who abandon honest work, merchants evading taxes, and fugitive bandits slip in by these routes.

sentences.zh: 萃為淵藪，交相鼓扇，深為邊患。

translations.literal: They gather into a deep lair, incite one another, and become a serious frontier affliction.
translations.idiomatic: They gather into a deep lair, rousing one another—a grave border menace.

sentences.zh: 如武岡楊再興、桂陽陳峒相繼為亂，實原於此。

translations.literal: Such as Yang Zaixing at Wugang and Chen Dong at Guiyang rising in rebellion one after another—the root truly lies here.
translations.idiomatic: The successive rebellions of Yang Zaixing at Wugang and Chen Dong at Guiyang originated here.

sentences.zh: 為今計者，宜徙閑地巡檢兵，及分遣士卒屯諸溪穀山徑間，俾湖南北、廣西帥憲總其役，庶幾事權有歸，號令可行也。

translations.literal: For the present plan, idle patrol troops should be transferred and soldiers dispatched to garrison among the stream-valley mountain paths, so that the route and circuit officials of Hunan, northern Hunan, and Guangxi oversee the task—then perhaps authority will have a home and orders can be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The remedy is to redeploy idle patrol troops and station soldiers at the mountain passes, coordinated by the route and circuit officials of Hunan, northern Hunan, and Guangxi, so authority is unified and orders can be enforced.

sentences.zh: ”儒林郎李大性上言：“比年徭蠻為亂，邊吏慮妨賞格，往往匿不以聞，遂致猖獗，使一方民命寄於徭人之手，誠可哀憫。

translations.literal: Ruilin Lang Li Daxing submitted: "In recent years Yao tribes have rebelled; frontier officials, fearing harm to reward quotas, often conceal reports and do not inform the court, leading to rampant violence so that the lives of a whole region depend on Yao people's hands—truly pitiable."
translations.idiomatic: Ruilin Lang Li Daxing wrote: "In recent years Yao tribes have rebelled, yet frontier officials, fearing lost credit for rewards, often suppress reports—allowing violence to run wild until an entire region's people hang by a Yao thread. It is pitiable."

sentences.zh: 近如梁牟等寇沅州，劫墟市，殺戮齊民，州縣告急於兩月之後，比調官軍討捕，俘降其賊，而人之被害已酷矣。

translations.literal: Recently, such as Liang Mou and others raiding Yuan Prefecture, plundering market towns, and slaughtering common people—the prefectures and counties reported urgent news only after two months; by the time official troops were mobilized to pursue and capture, accepting the surrender of the bandits, the harm to the people was already severe.
translations.idiomatic: Take the recent case of Liang Mou raiding Yuan Prefecture, looting markets, and killing civilians: prefectures and counties reported the emergency only two months later. By the time troops were mobilized and the bandits captured or surrendered, the damage was already grievous.

sentences.zh: 宜戒州縣或遇徭人竊發，畫時以聞，違者論罪。

translations.literal: It should be commanded that when prefectures and counties encounter Yao people rising stealthily, they report at once; violators should be punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties should be ordered to report any Yao uprising immediately, on pain of punishment.

sentences.zh: 仍命監司、帥臣常加覺察，庶幾先事備禦，俾徭人亦知畏懼，不敢侵軼，以傷吾民也。

translations.literal: Circuit commissioners and route officials should also be ordered to supervise constantly, so that defense may be prepared beforehand and Yao people too will know fear and dare not cross boundaries to harm our people.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit and route officials should supervise constantly so defenses are ready in advance—and Yao people will learn fear and cease crossing boundaries to harm our people.

sentences.zh: 十一年，詔給事中、中書舍人、戶部長貳同敕令所議，禁民毋質徭人田，以奪其業，俾能自養，以息邊釁。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, an edict directed the palace memorialists, secretariat drafters, and finance vice-ministers together with the drafting office to deliberate, prohibiting common people from pledging Yao people's fields to dispossess them of their livelihood, so they could support themselves and frontier troubles be stilled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year an edict directed memorialists, drafters, and finance vice-ministers together with the drafting office to ban pledging Yao land—preventing dispossession so Yao people could sustain themselves and border unrest subside.

sentences.zh: 從知沅州王鎮之請也。

translations.literal: This followed the request of Wang Zhenzhi, prefect of Yuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: This followed a petition from Yuan Prefecture prefect Wang Zhenzhi.

sentences.zh: 沅州生界犵狑副峒官吳自由子三人，貨丹砂麻陽縣，巡檢唐人傑誣為盜，執之送獄，自由率峒官楊友祿等謀為亂。

translations.literal: Three sons of Wu Ziyou, a Gelao sub-cave official in Yuan Prefecture's wild borderlands, were selling cinnabar in Mayang County; patrol officer Tang Renjie falsely accused them of banditry, arrested them, and sent them to prison. Ziyou then led cave officials including Yang Youlu in plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Three sons of Wu Ziyou, a Gelao sub-cave official in Yuan's wild borderlands, were selling cinnabar at Mayang County when patrol officer Tang Renjie falsely accused them of theft, arrested them, and sent them to jail. Ziyou then led cave officials including Yang Youlu in plotting revolt.

sentences.zh: 帥司調神勁軍三百人及沅州民兵屯境上，聲言進討。

translations.literal: The route command mobilized three hundred Shenjin Army troops and Yuan Prefecture militia to garrison the border, proclaiming a punitive advance.
translations.idiomatic: The route command mobilized three hundred Shenjin Army troops and Yuan militia to the border, announcing a punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 先遣歸明官田思忠往招撫之，以孔目官為質，世祿等既盟，自由取其三子以歸。

translations.literal: They first sent the pacified official Tian Sizhong to offer conciliation, holding a clerical officer as hostage; once Shilu and the others had sworn the oath, Ziyou recovered his three sons and returned.
translations.idiomatic: They first sent pacified official Tian Sizhong to negotiate, holding a clerical officer hostage. After Shilu and the others swore the oath, Ziyou reclaimed his three sons and returned home.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰三年，前知潭州、湖南安撫趙彥勵上言：“湖南九郡皆接溪峒，蠻夷叛服不常，深為邊患。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jiatai, Zhao Yanli, former prefect of Tan Prefecture and Hunan pacification commissioner, submitted: "All nine prefectures of Hunan border the stream-caves; tribal peoples submit and rebel unpredictably, a deep frontier affliction."
translations.idiomatic: In Jiatai 3 (1203), former Tan prefect and Hunan pacification commissioner Zhao Yanli wrote: "All nine Hunan prefectures border stream-caves where tribes submit and rebel by turns—a chronic border affliction."

sentences.zh: 製馭之方，豈無其說？

translations.literal: Are there not methods of control and restraint?
translations.idiomatic: Surely there must be a way to control them?

sentences.zh: 臣以為宜擇素有知勇為徭人所信服者，立為酋長，借補小官以鎮撫之。

translations.literal: Your subject considers that men of proven wisdom and courage trusted by Yao people should be chosen, established as chieftains, and given minor official appointments on loan to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: I believe we should select men of proven courage and wisdom whom the Yao trust, appoint them chieftains, and grant minor official titles to keep the peace.

sentences.zh: 況其習俗嗜欲悉同徭人，利害情偽莫不習知，故可坐而製服之也。

translations.literal: Moreover, their customs and desires are entirely the same as those of Yao people; they are thoroughly versed in interests, deceptions, and realities—therefore they can restrain them while seated.
translations.idiomatic: Their customs and appetites match the Yao's; they know tribal interests and deceptions intimately—so they can restrain them from their seats.

sentences.zh: 五年之間能立勞效，即與補正。

translations.literal: If within five years they establish meritorious service, they should at once receive regular appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Those who prove themselves within five years should receive regular appointments.

sentences.zh: 彼既榮顯其身，取重鄉曲，豈不自愛，盡忠公家哉？

translations.literal: Once they are honored in their persons and gain weight in their communities, would they not cherish themselves and serve the state loyally?
translations.idiomatic: Once honored in person and respected in their communities, would they not value themselves and serve the state faithfully?

sentences.zh: 所謂捐虛名而收實利，安邊之上策也。

translations.literal: This is what is called abandoning empty titles to gain real profit—the finest policy for securing the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: This is trading empty titles for real gain—the best frontier policy.

sentences.zh: ”帝下其議。

translations.literal: The Emperor referred the proposal down for discussion.
translations.idiomatic: The throne referred the proposal for discussion.

sentences.zh: 既而諸司復上言：“往時溪峒設首領、峒主、頭角官及防遏、指揮等使，皆其長也。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the various offices submitted again: "Formerly in the stream-caves there were established chieftains, cave lords, horn officials, and frontier-defense and command envoys—all were their own leaders."
translations.idiomatic: Soon various offices replied: "Stream-caves once had chieftains, cave lords, horn officials, and frontier-defense and command envoys—all drawn from their own leaders."

sentences.zh: 比年往往行賄得之，為害滋甚。

translations.literal: In recent years positions have often been obtained through bribery, and the harm has grown ever worse.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years these posts are often bought by bribery, causing ever greater harm.

sentences.zh: 今宜一新蠻夷耳目，如趙彥勵之請，所謂以蠻夷治蠻夷，策之上也。

translations.literal: Now tribal eyes and ears should be refreshed; as in Zhao Yanli's request, this is what is called using tribes to govern tribes—the finest policy.
translations.idiomatic: Tribal eyes should be refreshed now—as Zhao Yanli proposed, using tribes to govern tribes is the finest policy.

sentences.zh: ”帝從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor followed this.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 嘉定元年，郴州黑風峒徭人羅世傳寇邊，飛虎統製邊寧戰沒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiading, Yao people of Heifeng Cave in Chen Prefecture led by Luo Shichuan raided the border; Flying Tiger overall commander Bian Ning died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiading 1 (1208), Luo Shichuan of Heifeng Cave, Chen Prefecture, led Yao raiders against the border; Flying Tiger commander Bian Ning fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 江西、湖南驚擾，知隆興趙希懌、知潭州史彌堅共招降之。

translations.literal: Jiangxi and Hunan were alarmed and disturbed; Zhao Xichang, prefect of Longxing, and Shi Mijian, prefect of Tan Prefecture, jointly offered surrender terms.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi and Hunan were thrown into alarm; Longxing prefect Zhao Xichang and Tan prefect Shi Mijian jointly offered terms of surrender.

sentences.zh: 二年，李元礪、羅孟二寇江西，攻破龍泉縣。

translations.literal: In the second year, Li Yuanli and Luo Meng'er raided Jiangxi and captured Longquan County.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Li Yuanli and Luo Meng'er raided Jiangxi and took Longquan County.

sentences.zh: 李再興戰敗，死之，江州駐紮都統製趙選亦戰死。

translations.literal: Li Zaixing was defeated in battle and died; Zhao Xuan, overall commander of the Jiangzhou garrison, also died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zaixing was defeated and killed; Jiangzhou garrison overall commander Zhao Xuan also died in battle.

sentences.zh: 初，吉州獲賊長七人係獄，土豪黃從龍為賊畫策，賂吉守李絪，得縱還，賊遂無所忌。

translations.literal: At the beginning, Ji Prefecture captured seven bandit chiefs and imprisoned them; local strongman Huang Conglong plotted for the bandits, bribed Ji prefect Li Yin, and secured their release—after which the bandits had no restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Ji Prefecture had captured seven bandit chiefs and jailed them. Local strongman Huang Conglong plotted for the bandits, bribed Ji prefect Li Yin, and won their release—after which the bandits feared nothing.

sentences.zh: 有侯押隊者，領兵戍龍泉境上，元礪復用從龍計，椎牛釃酒以犒官軍。

translations.literal: There was a Commander Hou leading troops garrisoning the Longquan border; Yuanli again used Conglong's plan, slaughtering cattle and libating wine to feast the official army.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Hou was garrisoning the Longquan border when Yuanli again used Conglong's scheme—slaughtering cattle and pouring libations to feast the government troops.

sentences.zh: 賊至，官軍皆醉，狼狽散走。

translations.literal: When the bandits arrived, the official troops were all drunk and fled in disorder.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits struck, the troops were all drunk and fled in disarray.

sentences.zh: 寇之初起甚微，賊伺知議論不一，故玩侮官軍。

translations.literal: At the beginning the raid was very small; the bandits observed that policy discussion was not unified, and therefore treated the official army with contempt.
translations.idiomatic: The rebellion began very small; the bandits saw official policy was divided and treated the army with contempt.

sentences.zh: 方江西力戰則求降湖南，湖南戰則求降江西，牽製王師，使不得相應援。

translations.literal: Just as Jiangxi fought hard they sued for surrender in Hunan; when Hunan fought they sued for surrender in Jiangxi—splitting the royal forces so they could not support one another.
translations.idiomatic: While Jiangxi fought they sued for peace in Hunan; while Hunan fought they sued in Jiangxi—splitting the royal forces so they could not reinforce each other.

sentences.zh: 其後命工部侍郎王居安知豫章，擒獲之，溪峒略平。

translations.literal: Afterward the Ministry of Works vice-minister Wang Ju'an was appointed prefect of Yuzhang and captured them; the stream-caves were largely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Later Wang Ju'an of the Ministry of Works was appointed Yuzhang prefect and captured them; the stream-caves were largely pacified.

sentences.zh: 五年，臣僚上言：“辰、沅、靖等州舊嚐募民為弓弩手，給地以耕，俾為世業。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, a court official submitted: "Chen, Yuan, and Jing prefectures formerly recruited civilians as crossbowmen, granting land to farm so that it became hereditary occupation."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year a memorialist wrote: "Chen, Yuan, and Jing once recruited civilians as crossbowmen, granting farmland as hereditary livelihood."

sentences.zh: 邊陲獲保障之安，州縣無轉輸之費。

translations.literal: The frontier gained the security of protection, and prefectures and counties had no transport costs.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier gained secure protection and prefectures avoided supply costs.

sentences.zh: 比年多故，其製浸弛，徭蠻因之為亂，沿邊諸郡悉受其害。

translations.literal: In recent years many disruptions have occurred and the system has gradually slackened; Yao tribes rebelled because of it, and all border prefectures suffered harm.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years many disruptions caused the system to decay; Yao tribes rebelled in its wake and every border prefecture suffered.

sentences.zh: 比申朝廷調兵詔捕，曠日持久，蠻夷習玩，成其猖獗之勢。

translations.literal: Only when the court was petitioned to mobilize troops and issue capture edicts did days stretch into months; tribal peoples grew accustomed to contempt and formed a rampant power.
translations.idiomatic: Only when the court finally mobilized troops did months pass while tribes grew bold and their power ran rampant.

sentences.zh: 其如楊晟台、李金、姚明教、羅孟二、李元礪、陳廷佐之徒，皆近事之明驗也。

translations.literal: Such as Yang Shengtai, Li Jin, Yao Mingjiao, Luo Meng'er, Li Yuanli, Chen Tingzuo, and the like—all are clear proof from recent events.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shengtai, Li Jin, Yao Mingjiao, Luo Meng'er, Li Yuanli, Chen Tingzuo—these recent cases prove the point.

sentences.zh: 為今計者，宜講舊制，可紓饋餉之勞而得備禦之實，其安邊息民之長策歟。

translations.literal: For the present plan, the old system should be restored—it can relieve the labor of supply while gaining the reality of defense; is this not the long-term policy for securing the frontier and calming the people?
translations.idiomatic: The remedy is to restore the old system—easing supply burdens while gaining real defense. Is this not the lasting policy for securing the frontier and calming the people?

sentences.zh: 七年，臣僚復上言：“辰、沅、靖三州之地，多接溪峒，其居內地者謂之省民，熟戶、山徭、峒丁乃居外為捍蔽。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, court officials submitted again: "The lands of Chen, Yuan, and Jing prefectures largely border stream-caves; those dwelling in the interior are called provincial people, while settled households, mountain Yao, and cave militiamen live outside as shields."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year officials submitted again: "Chen, Yuan, and Jing largely border stream-caves. Interior dwellers are called provincial people; settled households, mountain Yao, and cave militiamen live outside as a shield."

sentences.zh: 其初，區處詳密，立法行事，悉有定制。

translations.literal: At the beginning, arrangements were detailed and meticulous; laws were established and affairs conducted—all had fixed regulations.
translations.idiomatic: At first arrangements were meticulous, with fixed regulations governing every practice.

sentences.zh: 峒丁等皆計口給田，多寡闊狹，疆畔井井，擅鬻者有禁，私易者有罰。

translations.literal: Cave militiamen and the like all received land by head count; whether much or little, broad or narrow, boundaries were marked square by square; unauthorized sale was forbidden and private transfer punished.
translations.idiomatic: Cave militiamen received land per capita—boundaries marked square by square. Unauthorized sales were forbidden and private transfers punished.

sentences.zh: 一夫歲輸租三鬥，無他繇役，故皆樂為之用。

translations.literal: Each man paid three pecks of rent annually with no other corvée, so all gladly served.
translations.idiomatic: Each man paid three pecks rent a year with no other corvée, so all served willingly.

sentences.zh: 邊陲有警，眾庶雲集，爭負弩矢前驅，出萬死不顧。

translations.literal: When the frontier had alarm, the multitude gathered like clouds, competing to carry crossbows and arrows in the vanguard, going forth without regard for ten thousand deaths.
translations.idiomatic: When the frontier alarm sounded, crowds gathered, competing to carry crossbows and arrows in the vanguard, risking death without hesitation.

sentences.zh: 比年防禁日弛，山徭、峒丁得私售田。

translations.literal: In recent years prohibitions have slackened day by day, and mountain Yao and cave militiamen have been able to sell land privately.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years prohibitions have slackened daily, and mountain Yao and cave militiamen have sold land privately.

sentences.zh: 田之歸於民者，常賦外復輸稅，公家因資之以為利，故謾不加省。

translations.literal: Land passing to common people paid tax beyond regular levies; the state profited from this and therefore deliberately failed to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Land passing to common people paid extra tax beyond regular levies; the state profited and deliberately looked the other way.

sentences.zh: 而山徭、峒丁之常租仍虛掛版籍，責其償益急，往往不能聊生，反寄命徭人，或導其入寇，為害滋甚。

translations.literal: Yet the regular rent of mountain Yao and cave militiamen still hung empty on the registers, and collection grew ever more urgent; often unable to sustain life, they instead entrusted their lives to Yao people or guided raids—increasing the harm.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the regular rent of mountain Yao and cave militiamen still hung on the registers while collection grew ever more urgent. Unable to live, they entrusted themselves to Yao people or guided raids—causing ever greater harm.

sentences.zh: 宜敕湖、廣監司檄諸郡，俾循舊制毋廢，庶邊境綏靖而遠人獲安也。

translations.literal: Hunan and Guang circuit commissioners should be ordered to instruct all prefectures to follow the old system without abolishing it, so that the border may be tranquil and distant peoples secure.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan and Guang circuit commissioners should order all prefectures to follow the old system without abolishing it, so the border is tranquil and distant peoples secure.

sentences.zh: 梅山峒

translations.literal: Meishan Dong.
translations.idiomatic: Meishan Dong

sentences.zh: 梅山峒蠻，舊不與中國通。

translations.literal: The Meishan cave tribes had not communicated with China.
translations.idiomatic: The Meishan cave tribes had no contact with China.

sentences.zh: 其地東接潭，南接邵，其西則辰，其北則鼎、澧，而梅山居其中。

translations.literal: Their land bordered Tan to the east and Shao to the south; to the west was Chen, and to the north Ding and Li—with Meishan in the center.
translations.idiomatic: Their land bordered Tan to the east, Shao to the south, Chen to the west, and Ding and Li to the north, with Meishan at the center.

sentences.zh: 開寶八年，嚐寇邵之武岡、潭之長沙。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Kaibao they raided Wugang in Shao and Changsha in Tan.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaibao 8 (975) they raided Wugang in Shao and Changsha in Tan.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年，左甲首領苞漢陽、右甲首領頓漢淩寇掠邊界，朝廷累遣使招諭，不聽，命客省使翟守素調潭州兵討平之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Taiping Xingguo, left-wing chieftain Bao Hanyang and right-wing chieftain Dun Hanling raided and plundered the border; the court repeatedly sent envoys to summon and instruct them but they would not listen, and ordered Guest Reception Commissioner Zhai Shousu to mobilize Tan Prefecture troops to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 2 (977), left-wing chieftain Bao Hanyang and right-wing chieftain Dun Hanling raided the border. The court repeatedly sent envoys to summon them, but they refused; Guest Reception Commissioner Zhai Shousu was ordered to mobilize Tan troops and suppress them.

sentences.zh: 自是，禁不得與漢民交通，其地不得耕牧。

translations.literal: From this time, traffic with Han commoners was forbidden and the land could not be farmed or grazed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter contact with Han commoners was forbidden and the land could not be farmed or grazed.

sentences.zh: 後有蘇方者居之，數侵奪舒、向二族。

translations.literal: Later a Su Fang dwelt there and repeatedly encroached upon the Shu and Xiang clans.
translations.idiomatic: Later a man named Su Fang settled there and repeatedly encroached on the Shu and Xiang clans.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐末，知益陽縣張頡收捕其桀黠符三等，遂經營開拓。

translations.literal: At the end of the Jiayou era, Yiyang magistrate Zhang Jie captured their ringleaders including Fu San and then undertook to open and develop the region.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Jiayou, Yiyang magistrate Zhang Jie captured ringleaders including Fu San and began opening the region for settlement.

sentences.zh: 安撫使吳中復以聞，其議中格。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Wu Zhongfu reported this, but the proposal was blocked midway.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner Wu Zhongfu reported the plan, but it was blocked midway.

sentences.zh: 湖南轉運副使範子奇復奏，蠻恃險為邊患，宜臣屬而郡縣之。

translations.literal: Hunan transport vice-commissioner Fan Ziqi memorialized again that the tribes relied on terrain for border trouble and should be placed under subjection and county administration.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan transport vice-commissioner Fan Ziqi memorialized again that the tribes, relying on terrain, were a border menace and should be brought under county administration.

sentences.zh: 子奇尋召還，又述前議。

translations.literal: Ziqi was soon recalled and again stated the earlier proposal.
translations.idiomatic: Ziqi was soon recalled to court and restated his earlier proposal.

sentences.zh: 熙寧五年，乃詔知潭州潘夙、湖南轉運副使蔡熚、判官喬執中同經製章惇招納之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xining, an edict directed Tan Prefecture prefect Pan Su, Hunan transport vice-commissioner Cai Bi, and administrative assistant Qiao Zhizhong together with Zhang Zhang to receive their submission.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 5 (1072) an edict directed Tan prefect Pan Su, Hunan transport vice-commissioner Cai Bi, and aide Qiao Zhizhong to join Zhang Zhang in receiving their submission.

sentences.zh: 惇遣執中知全州，將行，而大田三砦蠻犯境。

translations.literal: Zhang sent Qiao Zhizhong to govern Quan Prefecture; as he was about to depart, the Datian Three Stockade tribes violated the border.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang sent Qiao Zhizhong to govern Quan Prefecture, but as he prepared to depart the Datian Three Stockade tribes raided the border.

sentences.zh: 又飛山之蠻近在全州之西，執中至全州，大田諸蠻納款，於是遂檄諭開梅山，蠻徭爭辟道路，以待得其地。

translations.literal: Also the Feishan tribes were near the west of Quan Prefecture; when Zhizhong reached Quan Prefecture, the Datian tribes submitted, and thereupon he issued a proclamation to open Meishan—the tribal Yao competed to clear roads, awaiting possession of the land.
translations.idiomatic: The Feishan tribes lay just west of Quan. When Zhizhong arrived, the Datian tribes submitted; he then proclaimed the opening of Meishan, and tribal Yao competed to clear roads in anticipation of receiving the land.

sentences.zh: 東起寧鄉縣司徒嶺，西抵邵陽白沙砦，北界益陽四里河，南止湘鄉佛子嶺。

translations.literal: East from Situling in Ningxiang County, west to Baisha Stockade in Shaoyang, north bounded by Sili River in Yiyang, south ending at Foziling in Xiangxiang.
translations.idiomatic: The boundaries ran east from Situling in Ningxiang, west to Baisha Stockade in Shaoyang, north to Sili River in Yiyang, and south to Foziling in Xiangxiang.

sentences.zh: 籍其民，得主、客萬四千八百九戶，萬九千八十九丁。

translations.literal: Their population was registered: 14,809 registered and guest households, 19,089 males.
translations.idiomatic: A census registered 14,809 registered and guest households with 19,089 adult males.

sentences.zh: 田二十六萬四百三十六畝，均定其稅，使歲一輸。

translations.literal: There were 260,436 mu of fields; taxes were assessed uniformly for annual payment.
translations.idiomatic: There were 260,436 mu of fields; taxes were assessed uniformly for annual payment.

sentences.zh: 乃築武陽、關硤二城，詔以山地置新化縣，並二城隸邵州。

translations.literal: Wuyang and Guanxia two cities were then built; an edict established Xinhua County in the mountain lands, with both cities subordinate to Shao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wuyang and Guanxia cities were built; an edict created Xinhua County in the mountain lands, with both cities under Shao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 自是，鼎、澧可以南至邵。

translations.literal: From this time, Ding and Li could reach Shao from the south.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Ding and Li could reach Shao from the south.

sentences.zh: 誠、徽州

translations.literal: Chenghui and Huizhou Prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghui and Huizhou Prefectures

sentences.zh: 誠、徽州，唐溪峒州。

translations.literal: Chenghui and Huizhou Prefectures were Tang stream-cave prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghui and Huizhou were Tang-era stream-cave prefectures.

sentences.zh: 宋初，楊氏居之，號十峒首領，以其族姓散掌州峒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song, the Yang clan dwelt there, styled chieftains of ten caves, governing state caves in scattered fashion by clan surname.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Song the Yang clan held them, styled chieftains of ten caves, governing the prefectural caves through scattered clan branches.

sentences.zh: 太平興國四年，首領楊蘊始來內附。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo, chieftain Yang Yun first came to attach inward.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 4 (979) chieftain Yang Yun first submitted to the court.

sentences.zh: 五年，楊通寶始入貢，命為誠州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Yang Tongbao first entered with tribute and was appointed prefect of Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Yang Tongbao first presented tribute and was appointed prefect of Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 淳化二年，其刺史楊政岩復來貢。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chunhua, its prefect Yang Zhengyan again came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 2 (991) its prefect Yang Zhengyan again presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 是歲，政岩卒，以其子通盈繼知州事。

translations.literal: That year Zhengyan died, and his son Tong Ying succeeded to know the prefecture affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhengyan died, and his son Tong Ying succeeded as acting prefect.

sentences.zh: 熙寧八年，有楊光富者，率其族姓二十三州峒歸附，詔以光富為右班殿直，昌運五人補三班奉職，晟情等十六人補三司軍將。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xining, a Yang Guangfu led twenty-three state caves of his clan surname to submit; an edict appointed Guangfu Right Gate Guard Direct Attendant, five men including Changyun as Supplementary Third-Rank Attendants, and sixteen men including Shengqing as Three-Directorate Military Generals.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 8 (1075) Yang Guangfu led twenty-three clan caves to submit. Guangfu was appointed Right Gate Guard Direct Attendant; Changyun and four others received Supplementary Third-Rank Attendants; Shengqing and fifteen others received Three-Directorate Military General appointments.

sentences.zh: 繼有楊昌銜者，亦願罷進奉，出租賦為漢民，詔補為右班殿直，子弟侄十八人補授有差。

translations.literal: Then Yang Changxian also wished to cease tribute submission and pay rent and tax as Han commoners; an edict appointed him Right Gate Guard Direct Attendant, and eighteen sons, younger brothers, and nephews received appointments at varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Then Yang Changxian also wished to end tribute and pay rent and tax as Han subjects. He was appointed Right Gate Guard Direct Attendant; eighteen sons, brothers, and nephews received appointments at varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 獨光僭頗負固不從命，詔湖南轉運使朱初平羈縻之，未幾亦降，乃與其子日儼請於其側建學舍，求名士教子孫。

translations.literal: Only Guangjian was quite stubborn and would not obey orders; an edict ordered Hunan transport commissioner Zhu Chuping to manage him by loose rein, and before long he too surrendered. Then he and his son Riyan requested a school built beside them, seeking renowned scholars to teach their descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Only Guangjian remained stubborn and defied orders. Hunan transport commissioner Zhu Chuping was ordered to manage him by loose rein; soon he too surrendered. He and his son Riyan then requested a school built nearby and sought renowned scholars to educate their descendants.

sentences.zh: 詔潭州長史樸成為徽、誠等州教授；

translations.literal: An edict appointed Tan Prefecture chief recorder Pu Cheng professor for Huizhou, Chen, and other prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Tan chief recorder Pu Cheng as professor for Huizhou, Chen, and other prefectures;

sentences.zh: 光僭皇城使、誠州刺史致仕，官為建宅；

translations.literal: Guangjian retired as Imperial City Commissioner and Chen Prefecture prefect, and the state built his residence;
translations.idiomatic: Guangjian retired as Imperial City Commissioner and Chen Prefecture prefect, with the state building his residence;

sentences.zh: 置飛山一帶道路巡檢。

translations.literal: a frontier road patrol inspector was established for the Feishan belt.
translations.idiomatic: a road patrol inspector was established for the Feishan region.

sentences.zh: 光僭未及拜而卒，遂以贈之，錄其子六人。

translations.literal: Guangjian died before he could assume office, and posthumous titles were therefore granted; six of his sons were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: Guangjian died before taking office; posthumous honors were granted and six sons enrolled in service.

sentences.zh: 元豐三年，知邵州關杞請於徽、誠州融嶺鎮擇要害地築城砦，以絕邊患。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfeng, Shao Prefecture prefect Guan Qi requested choosing strategic ground at Rongling town in Huizhou and Chen Prefecture to build fortified stockades and cut off border trouble.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng 3 (1080) Shao prefect Guan Qi requested building fortified stockades at strategic points in Rongling town, Huizhou and Chen Prefecture, to eliminate border trouble.

sentences.zh: 詔湖南安撫謝景溫、轉運使朱初平、判官趙揚商度以聞，景溫等以為宜如杞言。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Hunan pacification commissioner Xie Jingwen, transport commissioner Zhu Chuping, and judicial officer Zhao Yang to deliberate and report; Jingwen and the others held that Qi’s proposal should be followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Hunan pacification commissioner Xie Jingwen, transport commissioner Zhu Chuping, and judicial officer Zhao Yang to study the matter and report back. Jingwen and his colleagues agreed that Guan Qi’s plan should be adopted.

sentences.zh: 乃議誠州以沅州貫保砦為渠陽縣隸之，以徽州為蒔竹縣隸邵州。
