translations.literal: They then deliberated that Chen Prefecture should take Yuan Prefecture’s Guanbao stockade as Qeyang County subordinate to it, and that Huizhou should become Shizhu County subordinate to Shao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: They then proposed making Guanbao stockade in Yuan Prefecture into Qeyang County under Chen Prefecture, and converting Huizhou into Shizhu County under Shao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 趙揚言上江、多星、銅鼓、羊鎮、潭溪、上和、上誠、天村、大田等團並至誠州城下貿易，可漸招撫，並乞下湖南邵州蒔竹縣招諭芙蓉、萬驛諸團，從之，徒誠州治渠陽而貫保為砦如故。

translations.literal: Zhao Yang said that the communities of Shangjiang, Duoxing, Tonggu, Yangzhen, Tanxi, Shanghe, Shangcheng, Tiancun, Datian, and others all came to trade below Chen Prefecture’s walls and could gradually be won over; he also requested orders to Shizhu County in Hunan’s Shao Prefecture to summon and instruct the Furong, Wanyi, and other communities. The request was granted; Chen Prefecture’s seat was moved to Qeyang while Guanbao remained a stockade as before.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yang reported that the Shangjiang, Duoxing, Tonggu, Yangzhen, Tanxi, Shanghe, Shangcheng, Tiancun, Datian, and other tribal communities all came to trade at Chen Prefecture and could be gradually brought under control. He also asked that Shizhu County in Shao Prefecture be ordered to summon the Furong, Wanyi, and other communities. The court agreed. Chen Prefecture’s seat was moved to Qeyang, while Guanbao remained a stockade as before.

sentences.zh: 上江等諸團果皆納土，於是增築多星等砦，還連徽、廣西融州王口砦焉。

translations.literal: The Shangjiang and other communities indeed all submitted their lands; stockades such as Duoxing were then expanded and fortified, linking once again with Huizhou and Wangkou stockade in Guangxi’s Rong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Shangjiang communities and the rest duly submitted. Duoxing and other stockades were then expanded and fortified, reestablishing links with Huizhou and Wangkou stockade in Rong Prefecture, Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 元祐二年，改誠州為渠陽軍，罷兩州兵馬及守禦民丁。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanyou, Chen Prefecture was changed to Qeyang Army; the military forces and defensive civilian levies of both prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanyou 2 (1087) Chen Prefecture was redesignated Qeyang Army, and the troops and defensive civilian levies of both prefectures were disbanded.

sentences.zh: 有楊晟台者，乘間寇文村堡，知渠陽軍胡田措置亡術，蠻結西融州蠻砦粟仁催，往來兩路為民患，調兵屯渠陽至萬人，湖南亦增屯兵應援，三路俱驚。

translations.literal: There was one Yang Shengtai who seized an opening to raid Wencun fort. Qeyang Army commander Hu Tian was inept in his arrangements; the tribes joined with Suren of a tribal stockade west in Rong Prefecture, moving back and forth along both routes and becoming a scourge to the people. Troops were mobilized and garrisoned at Qeyang, reaching ten thousand men; Hunan also increased garrison troops in support, and all three circuits were alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: A man named Yang Shengtai seized the moment to raid Wencun fort. Qeyang Army commander Hu Tian handled matters poorly. Shengtai allied with Suren of a tribal stockade in western Rong Prefecture and raided back and forth along both routes, plaguing the populace. Ten thousand troops were stationed at Qeyang; Hunan also sent reinforcements, and all three frontier circuits were thrown into alarm.

sentences.zh: 朝廷方務省事，議廢堡砦，徹戍守，而以其地予蠻，乃詔湖北轉運副使李茂直招撫，又遣唐乂同措置邊事討之。

translations.literal: The court was then intent on reducing affairs and deliberated abolishing forts and stockades, withdrawing garrisons, and granting the land to the tribes. An edict ordered Hubei transport vice commissioner Li Maozhi to win them over, and Tang Yi was also dispatched jointly to manage border affairs and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: The court, eager to simplify administration, considered abandoning the forts and stockades, withdrawing the garrisons, and turning the territory over to the tribes. Li Maozhi, vice transport commissioner of Hubei, was ordered to win them over, and Tang Yi was sent to manage border affairs and campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 後以渠陽為誠州，命光僭之子供備庫使昌達、供備庫副使楊昌等同知州事，而貫保、豐山、若水等砦皆罷戍，擇授土官，俾乂間毀樓櫓，撤官舍，護領居民入砦。

translations.literal: Later Qeyang was made Chen Prefecture again. Guangjian’s son, Storehouse Provision Commissioner Changda, and Deputy Storehouse Provision Commissioner Yang Chang were appointed jointly to know prefectural affairs. Garrisons at Guanbao, Fengshan, Ruoshui, and other stockades were all withdrawn; native officials were selected and appointed. Yi was ordered in intervals to destroy towers and parapets, remove official buildings, and escort residents into the stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Qeyang was later restored as Chen Prefecture. Guangjian’s son Changda, Storehouse Provision Commissioner, and Yang Chang, Deputy Storehouse Provision Commissioner, were appointed jointly as acting prefects. Garrisons at Guanbao, Fengshan, Ruoshui, and other stockades were withdrawn and native officials appointed in their place. Yi was ordered to dismantle towers and parapets, tear down official buildings, and escort residents into the stockades.

sentences.zh: 崇寧初，改誠州為靖州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chongning, Chen Prefecture was changed to Jing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Chongning era (1102), Chen Prefecture was renamed Jing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 南丹州

translations.literal: Nandan Prefecture
translations.idiomatic: Nandan Prefecture

sentences.zh: 南丹州蠻，亦溪峒之別種也，地與宜州及西南夷接壤。

translations.literal: The tribes of Nandan Prefecture were also a separate branch of the stream-cave peoples; their lands bordered Yizhou and the southwestern barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes of Nandan Prefecture were another branch of the stream-cave peoples, living along the borders of Yizhou and the southwestern tribes.

sentences.zh: 開寶七年，酋帥莫洪[B16D]遣使陳紹規奉表求內附。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Kaibao, chieftain Mo Hong[B16D] dispatched envoy Chen Shaogui to present a memorial requesting inward attachment.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaibao 7 (974) chieftain Mo Hong sent envoy Chen Shaogui with a memorial requesting submission to the court.

sentences.zh: 九年，復來貢，求賜牌印，詔刻印以給之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year they again came with tribute, requesting plaques and seals; an edict ordered seals carved and given to them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year they returned with tribute and requested official plaques and seals. The court ordered seals carved and issued to them.

sentences.zh: 太平興國五年，洪[B16D]貢銀百兩，以賀太平。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo, Hong[B16D] presented one hundred taels of silver to congratulate the age of peace.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 5 (980) Mo Hong presented one hundred taels of silver to celebrate the era of peace.

sentences.zh: 雍熙四年，洪[B16D]族人知寶隆鎮莫淮閬牛一頭，逐水草至金城州河池縣，宜州牙校周承鑒以其牛耕作，淮閬三遣人取牛，承鑒不還，凡耕十日，始釋牛逐水草去。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongxi, a clansman of Hong[B16D], Mo Huailang, magistrate of Baolong town, had one ox that followed grass and water to Hechi County in Jincheng Prefecture. Yizhou garrison officer Zhou Chengjian used the ox to plow. Huailang three times sent men to reclaim the ox, but Chengjian would not return it. After plowing for ten days in all, he finally released the ox to follow grass and water away.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 4 (987) Mo Huailang, a kinsman of Mo Hong and magistrate of Baolong town, lost track of an ox that had wandered with the grazing to Hechi County in Jincheng Prefecture. Yizhou garrison officer Zhou Chengjian seized the animal and used it to plow. Huailang sent men three times to reclaim it, but Chengjian refused. Only after ten days of plowing did he finally release the ox to wander off again.

sentences.zh: 淮閬怒，領鄉兵六十人劫取承鑒家資財，驅縣民莫世家牛六頭以歸，誘群蠻為寇。

translations.literal: Huailang was enraged. Leading sixty local militiamen he plundered Chengjian’s household goods and property, drove off six oxen belonging to a county commoner surnamed Mo, and returned home, inciting the tribal groups to raid.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged, Huailang led sixty local militiamen to plunder Chengjian’s household, drove off six oxen belonging to a county commoner named Mo, and returned home, inciting the tribes to raid.

sentences.zh: 上遣供奉官王承緒乘傳劾承鑒，具伏占牛，詔棄市。

translations.literal: The emperor dispatched palace attendant Wang Chengxu by express relay to investigate Chengjian; he fully confessed to seizing the ox, and an edict ordered execution by dismemberment in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent palace attendant Wang Chengxu by express relay to investigate Chengjian. Chengjian confessed fully to seizing the ox, and the court ordered him executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 時知宜州、讚善大夫侯汀失於備禦，群蠻之擾，頗害及民庶，詔發諸州兵進討，兵未至，悉已遁歸，汀坐免官。

translations.literal: At the time Yizhou prefect, Supporter of Goodness Grand Master Hou Ting, had failed in defense; the disturbances of the tribal groups had considerably harmed the common people. An edict ordered troops from various prefectures to advance in suppression, but before the troops arrived all had already fled back. Ting was dismissed from office on that account.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhou prefect Hou Ting, Supporter of Goodness Grand Master, had failed to maintain defenses, and the tribal raids had done considerable harm to the people. Troops from several prefectures were ordered to campaign against them, but the raiders fled before the army arrived. Ting was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 詔諭宜、融、柳州百姓及蠻界人戶曰：“朕托兆庶之上，處司牧之重，照臨所暨，撫養是均，矧於遐陬，尤所軫慮。

translations.literal: An edict instructed the common people of Yizhou, Rongzhou, and Liuzhou and the households on the tribal frontier, saying: “I stand above the myriad people, bearing the heavy charge of shepherd and steward. Wherever my gaze reaches, nurturing care is equal; how much more so in distant corners, which I especially keep in mind.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued to the people of Yizhou, Rongzhou, and Liuzhou and to households on the tribal frontier: “I stand above the myriad people, charged with shepherding the realm. Wherever my authority extends, I nurture all alike—and distant borderlands I hold especially close to heart.

sentences.zh: 昨以知宜州事侯汀失於綏緝，恣其侵牟，致茲邊夷，起為寇鈔，侵騷閭裏，虔劉士庶。

translations.literal: Recently, because Hou Ting, who knew the affairs of Yizhou, failed in pacification and restraint and allowed free encroachment and exaction, these frontier tribes rose as raiding bandits, harassing villages and neighborhoods and slaughtering officials and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Hou Ting, acting prefect of Yizhou, failed to keep order and allowed encroachment and exaction to run unchecked. The frontier tribes therefore rose in raids, harassing villages and slaughtering officials and commoners alike.

sentences.zh: 及興師而討伐，乃畏威而竄伏。

translations.literal: When troops were raised to campaign against them, they then feared authority and hid in flight.
translations.idiomatic: When troops were raised against them, they feared imperial might and fled into hiding.

sentences.zh: 朕以興戎召釁，職由於汀，爰舉國章，削其官秩。

translations.literal: I hold that raising arms and inviting conflict was a fault arising from Ting; therefore I have invoked the statutes of the state and stripped him of rank and office.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that war was provoked through Ting’s fault. I have therefore invoked the law of the realm and stripped him of rank and office.

sentences.zh: 汝等所宜體予含垢，革乃前非，安土厚生，保境延世，嬉我至化，是為永圖。

translations.literal: You ought to embody my forbearance in swallowing disgrace, reform your former wrongs, settle the land and enrich your lives, preserve your borders and extend your generations, and rejoice in my utmost transforming influence—this is the lasting design.
translations.idiomatic: You should accept my forbearance, amend your former wrongs, settle peacefully and prosper, guard your borders and preserve your lineages, and rejoice in my civilizing rule. That is the path to lasting peace.

sentences.zh: 或尚恣於陸梁，當盡剿其族類。

translations.literal: If any still indulge in lawless violence, their entire clans shall be exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: If any still persist in lawless violence, their entire clans will be exterminated.

sentences.zh: ”自是不復為寇。
淳化元年，洪[B16D]卒，其弟洪皓襲稱刺史，遣其子淮通來貢銀碗二十，銅鼓三面，銅印一鈕，旗一帖，繡真珠紅羅襦一。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chunhua, Hong[B16D] died. His younger brother Hong Hao succeeded in claiming the title of prefect and dispatched his son Huaitong to present tribute of twenty silver bowls, three bronze drums, one bronze seal with knob, one banner sheet, and one embroidered pearl-red silk jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 1 (990) Mo Hong died. His younger brother Hong Hao succeeded as prefect and sent his son Huaitong with tribute: twenty silver bowls, three bronze drums, one bronze seal, one banner, and one pearl-embroidered red silk jacket.

sentences.zh: 上降優詔，賜彩百匹，還其襦。

translations.literal: The emperor issued a gracious edict, bestowing one hundred bolts of colored silk and returning the jacket.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued a gracious edict, granting one hundred bolts of colored silk and returning the jacket.

sentences.zh: 自洪[B16D]領州十餘年，歲輸白金百兩。

translations.literal: From the time Hong[B16D] held the prefecture for more than ten years, he paid one hundred taels of white silver annually.
translations.idiomatic: During Mo Hong’s more than ten years as prefect, he paid one hundred taels of silver in tribute each year.

sentences.zh: 洪皓之襲兄位，專其地利，不修常貢。

translations.literal: When Hong Hao succeeded to his elder brother’s position, he monopolized the local profits and did not maintain the regular tribute.
translations.idiomatic: When Hong Hao succeeded his elder brother, he kept the local profits for himself and ceased paying regular tribute.

sentences.zh: 其弟洪沅忿之，挈妻子來奔宜州。

translations.literal: His younger brother Hong Huai resented this and brought wife and children to flee to Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Hong Huai, resentful of this, fled with his wife and children to Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 洪皓怒其背己，數引兵攻洪沅。

translations.literal: Hong Hao, angered that he had turned against him, repeatedly led troops to attack Hong Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Hao, enraged at this defection, repeatedly led troops against Hong Huai.

sentences.zh: 洪沅與二男並牙將一人，乘傳詣闕訴其事，請發兵致討。

translations.literal: Hong Huai, together with two sons and one garrison general, traveled by express relay to the court to plead the matter and request troops be sent to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Huai traveled to court by express relay with two sons and a garrison officer to plead his case and request a punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 上以蠻夷之俗，羈縻而已，不欲為之興師報怨。

translations.literal: The emperor held that in the customs of the tribal barbarians, loose-rein management was sufficient and did not wish to raise armies over private grievances.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that tribal peoples were to be managed by loose rein and did not wish to raise armies over private feuds.

sentences.zh: 洪沅先自稱南丹州副使，以為邵州團練使，給田十頃，下詔戒敕洪皓。

translations.literal: Hong Huai had earlier styled himself vice commissioner of Nandan Prefecture; he was appointed regimental training commissioner of Shao Prefecture and granted ten qing of land. An edict was issued admonishing Hong Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Huai, who had styled himself vice commissioner of Nandan Prefecture, was appointed regimental training commissioner of Shao Prefecture and granted ten qing of land. An edict was issued warning Hong Hao.

sentences.zh: 景德二年，洪皓死，長子淮襲父任。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingde, Hong Hao died, and his eldest son Huai succeeded to his father’s post.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingde 2 (1005) Hong Hao died, and his eldest son Huai succeeded to his father’s post.

sentences.zh: 俄為弟淮辿攻南丹州，淮帥屬來奔，詔宜州賜閑田資給之。

translations.literal: Before long he was attacked at Nandan Prefecture by his younger brother Huai Huainai. Huai led his followers to flee inward, and an edict ordered Yizhou to grant idle land and provide support.
translations.idiomatic: Before long his younger brother Huai Huainai attacked Nandan Prefecture. Huai fled with his followers to the court, and Yizhou was ordered to grant them idle land and provide support.

sentences.zh: 大中詳符五年，宜州言淮辿頗集諸蠻，阻富仁監道路，上廉知淮辿無侵擾狀，遣使犒設撫勞之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, Yizhou reported that Huai Huainai had gathered many tribes and blocked the road at Furen supervisory post. The emperor, knowing that Huai Huainai had not engaged in harassment, dispatched envoys with rewards and comfort to soothe and encourage him.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 5 (1012) Yizhou reported that Huai Huainai had gathered many tribes and blocked the road at Furen supervisory post. Learning that Huai Huainai had not harassed the frontier, the emperor sent envoys with rewards to soothe and encourage him.

sentences.zh: 九年，撫水蠻叛，詔淮辿約勒溪峒，勿從誘脅。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the Fushui tribes rebelled; an edict ordered Huai Huainai to restrain the stream caves and not follow seduction and coercion.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the Fushui tribes rebelled. Huai Huainai was ordered to restrain the stream-cave peoples and not join the rebellion under coercion.

sentences.zh: 明年，平撫水蠻，淮辿等並以勞進秩。

translations.literal: The next year the Fushui tribes were pacified, and Huai Huainai and others were all promoted in rank for their labors.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, after the Fushui tribes were pacified, Huai Huainai and others were promoted for their service.

sentences.zh: 景祐三年，有淮戟者舉族來歸，命為湖南州團練副使，敕州縣拊存。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jingyou, one Huaiji led his entire clan to submit; he was appointed vice regimental training commissioner of Hunan Prefecture, and prefectures and counties were ordered to soothe and preserve them.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingyou 3 (1036) Huaiji led his entire clan to submit. He was appointed vice regimental training commissioner of Hunan Prefecture, and local officials were ordered to care for them.

sentences.zh: 後淮辿老，自言願傳其子世漸。

translations.literal: Later, when Huai Huainai grew old, he himself said he wished to transmit his post to his son Shijian.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as Huai Huainai grew old, he asked to pass his post to his son Shijian.

sentences.zh: 至和元年，命世漸為檢校散騎常侍，權發遣州事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhihe, Shijian was appointed honorary Regular Attendant of the Crown Prince’s Palace and authorized provisionally to dispatch prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhihe 1 (1054) Shijian was appointed honorary Regular Attendant of the Crown Prince’s Palace and authorized to act as prefect.

sentences.zh: 明年，以淮辿為懷遠大將軍致仕，世漸為刺史、檢校工部尚書，賜袍帶，錢十萬，絹百匹。

translations.literal: The next year Huai Huainai was retired as Grand General for Cherishing the Distant, and Shijian was made prefect and honorary Minister of Works; robes and belt were bestowed, along with one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Huai Huainai retired as Grand General for Cherishing the Distant. Shijian was appointed prefect and honorary Minister of Works, and was granted robes and belt, one hundred thousand cash, and one hundred bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 又補其親黨數十人為檢校官，如故事也。

translations.literal: Several dozen of his kinsmen and partisans were also appointed honorary officials, according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Several dozen of his kinsmen and followers were also given honorary appointments, as was customary.

sentences.zh: 世漸死，嘉祐末，命其子公帳襲之。

translations.literal: When Shijian died, near the end of Jiayou his son Gongzhang was ordered to succeed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Shijian died near the end of the Jiayou era (1056–1063), his son Gongzhang was appointed to succeed him.

sentences.zh: 有世忍者，亦淮辿之子也。

translations.literal: There was one Shiren, also a son of Huai Huainai.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Shiren, another son of Huai Huainai.

sentences.zh: 初率其屬人內附，治平初逃歸，攻殺公帳，奪其地自首，請於朝廷，願授刺史，補其親黨如故事，歲輸銀百兩。

translations.literal: At first he led his followers to submit inward. At the beginning of Zhiping he fled back, attacked and killed Gongzhang, seized his territory, and surrendered himself. He requested of the court that he be granted the prefecture, that his kinsmen and partisans be appointed according to precedent, and that he pay one hundred taels of silver annually.
translations.idiomatic: He had first led his followers to submit to the court. At the start of the Zhiping era (1064) he fled back, killed Gongzhang, seized his territory, and surrendered himself. He asked the court to appoint him prefect, grant honorary offices to his kinsmen as customary, and pay one hundred taels of silver in annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年，遂命為刺史，皆如其請。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed prefect, all as he had requested.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was appointed prefect, with all his requests granted.

sentences.zh: 熙寧二年，徭賊殺人，世忍執以獻，授檢校禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xining, Yao bandits killed people; Shiren seized them and presented them, and was appointed honorary Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: In Xining 2 (1069) Yao bandits killed people. Shiren captured them and turned them over to the authorities, and was appointed honorary Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 元豐三年入貢，其印以“西南諸道武盛軍德政官家明天國主”為文，詔以南丹州印賜之，令毀其舊印。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfeng he entered with tribute; his seal bore the inscription “Lord of the Bright Heaven Kingdom, Virtuous Ruler of the Martial Flourishing Army of the Southwestern Routes.” An edict bestowed the Nandan Prefecture seal and ordered his old seal destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfeng 3 (1080) he presented tribute. His seal bore the inscription “Lord of the Bright Heaven Kingdom, Virtuous Ruler of the Martial Flourishing Army of the Southwestern Routes.” The court granted him the Nandan Prefecture seal and ordered his old one destroyed.

sentences.zh: 六年，大軍討安化，世忍獻弓矢，自言願世世為外臣，修貢不懈，遷檢校戶部尚書，給銅牌旗號，官其子侄九人。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when the great army campaigned against Anhua, Shiren presented bows and arrows and himself said he wished generation after generation to serve as an outer subject, maintaining tribute without slackening. He was promoted to honorary Minister of Revenue; bronze plaques and banner tokens were granted, and nine sons and nephews were given offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, during the campaign against Anhua, Shiren presented bows and arrows and declared his wish to remain a loyal outer subject for generations, maintaining tribute without fail. He was promoted to honorary Minister of Revenue, granted bronze plaques and banner tokens, and nine sons and nephews received appointments.

sentences.zh: 世忍死，子公佞襲。

translations.literal: When Shiren died, his son Gongren succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Shiren died, his son Gongren succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 大觀元年，廣西經略使王祖道言公佞就擒。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daguan, Guangxi frontier commissioner Wang Zudao reported that Gongren had been captured.
translations.idiomatic: In Daguan 1 (1107) Guangxi frontier commissioner Wang Zudao reported that Gongren had been captured.

sentences.zh: 進築平、允、從州，牧文、地、蘭、那、安、外、習、南丹八州之地，並為鎮庭孚觀州、延德軍，以其弟公晟襲刺史。

translations.literal: They advanced in building Ping, Yun, and Cong prefectures, governing the lands of eight prefectures—Wen, Di, Lan, Na, An, Wai, Xi, and Nandan—and together established Zhenting Fu Guan Prefecture and Yande Army. Gongren’s younger brother Gong Sheng succeeded as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: The court advanced by building Ping, Yun, and Cong prefectures, bringing under control the eight prefectures of Wen, Di, Lan, Na, An, Wai, Xi, and Nandan, and establishing Zhenting Fu Guan Prefecture and Yande Army. Gongren’s younger brother Gong Sheng succeeded as prefect.

sentences.zh: 宣和四年，公晟乞以州事付其侄延豐，願與其子歸朝，詔從之，仍乘驛給券。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xuanhe, Gong Sheng requested that prefectural affairs be entrusted to his nephew Yanfeng and expressed his wish to return to court with his son. An edict granted this and also provided post-horses and travel warrants.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe 4 (1122) Gong Sheng asked to entrust prefectural affairs to his nephew Yanfeng and requested to return to court with his son. The court agreed and provided post-horses and travel warrants.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年，公晟攻圍觀州，焚寶積監。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxing, Gong Sheng besieged Guan Prefecture and burned Baoji supervisory post.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 3 (1133) Gong Sheng besieged Guan Prefecture and burned Baoji supervisory post.

sentences.zh: 朱勝非奏：“崇、觀、宣和間所開新邊，比來往往棄而不守，帥臣、監司屢言觀州為控扼之地。

translations.literal: Zhu Shengfei memorialized: “The new frontiers opened during the Chongning, Daguan, and Xuanhe periods have recently often been abandoned and left undefended. Commanders and supervisory officials have repeatedly said that Guan Prefecture is a place of strategic control.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shengfei memorialized: “The new frontier territories opened during the Chongning, Daguan, and Xuanhe eras have lately been abandoned one after another. Frontier commanders and supervisory officials have repeatedly argued that Guan Prefecture is a strategic choke point.

sentences.zh: 不宜棄。

translations.literal: It should not be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: It should not be abandoned.

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“前日用事之臣，貪功生事，公為欺罔，其實勞民費財，使遠俗不安也。

translations.literal: ” The emperor said: “The officials in power in earlier days, greedy for merit, created incidents and openly deceived. In truth they exhausted the people and wasted resources, leaving distant peoples unsettled.
translations.idiomatic: ” The emperor replied: “The officials in power back then, greedy for glory, manufactured incidents and deceived the court. In truth they exhausted the people, wasted resources, and left distant tribes unsettled.

sentences.zh: ”又用廣南經略安撫使劉彥適言，以公晟知南丹州兼溪峒都巡檢使、提舉盜賊公事，給以南丹州刺史舊印，公晟未受命。

translations.literal: ” Acting on the recommendation of Guangnan frontier pacification commissioner Liu Yanshi, Gong Sheng was appointed to know Nandan Prefecture while also serving as overall stream-cave patrol inspector and commissioner for bandit suppression. The old seal of the Nandan prefect was given to him, but Gong Sheng did not accept the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: ” Following the recommendation of Guangnan frontier pacification commissioner Liu Yanshi, Gong Sheng was appointed prefect of Nandan Prefecture, concurrently overall stream-cave patrol inspector and commissioner for bandit suppression. He was given the old Nandan prefect’s seal, but Gong Sheng did not accept the appointment.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，公晟始貢馬，率諸蠻來歸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Gong Sheng first presented horses in tribute and led the various tribes to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year (1154) Gong Sheng first presented horses in tribute and led the various tribes to submit.

sentences.zh: 帝諭輔臣曰：“得南丹非為廣地也，但徭人不叛，百姓安業，為可喜耳。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed the chief ministers, saying: “Gaining Nandan is not for expanding territory; it is simply that the Yao do not rebel and the common people pursue their livelihoods in peace—that is what is worth rejoicing over.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told his chief ministers: “Gaining Nandan is not about expanding territory. What matters is that the Yao do not rebel and the people live in peace—that is what is worth celebrating.

sentences.zh: ”遂以延沈襲公晟職，授銀青光祿大夫、檢校太子賓客、使持節南丹州諸軍事、南丹州刺史兼御史大夫、知南丹州公事、武騎尉。

translations.literal: ” Yan Shen was then ordered to succeed Gong Sheng’s post and was granted Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, honorary Guest of the Crown Prince, commissioner with full credentials for all military affairs of Nandan Prefecture, prefect of Nandan and concurrent Grand Censor, knowing the affairs of Nandan Prefecture, and Martial Rider Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: ” Yan Shen was then appointed to succeed Gong Sheng, with the titles Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, honorary Guest of the Crown Prince, commissioner with full credentials for all military affairs of Nandan Prefecture, prefect of Nandan and concurrent Grand Censor, acting prefect of Nandan, and Martial Rider Commandant.

sentences.zh: 廣西經略安撫使呂願中諭降諸蠻三十二種，得州二十七，縣一百三十五，砦四十，峒一百七十九及一鎮、三十二團，皆為羈縻州縣。

translations.literal: Guangxi frontier pacification commissioner Lü Yuanzhong announced the submission of thirty-two tribal groups, gaining twenty-seven prefectures, one hundred thirty-five counties, forty stockades, one hundred seventy-nine caves, one town, and thirty-two communities—all established as loose-rein prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi frontier pacification commissioner Lü Yuanzhong announced the submission of thirty-two tribal groups, bringing under control twenty-seven prefectures, one hundred thirty-five counties, forty stockades, one hundred seventy-nine caves, one town, and thirty-two communities—all registered as loose-rein prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，延沈進補團練、防禦二使。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Yan Shen was further promoted to regimental training and defense commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year (1155) Yan Shen was further promoted to regimental training and defense commissioner.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，延沈恣行慘酷，為諸蠻所逐，歸死省地，眾推延廩襲職。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year Yan Shen indulged in cruel conduct and was driven out by the various tribes. He returned and died in provincial territory, and the multitude pushed Yan Lin to succeed to the post.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year (1161) Yan Shen ruled with cruelty and was driven out by the tribes. He returned to provincial territory and died there, and the tribes installed Yan Lin in his place.

sentences.zh: 隆興二年，延廩復為諸蠻所圖，攜家歸朝，經略司奏以延葚襲職。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longxing, Yan Lin was again plotted against by the various tribes. He brought his family to return to court, and the frontier commission memorialized that Yan Shen should succeed to the post.
translations.idiomatic: In Longxing 2 (1164) Yan Lin was again targeted by the tribes. He fled to court with his family, and the frontier commission memorialized that Yan Shen should succeed to the post.

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年，南丹為永樂州所攻，使來告急，廣西帥臣遣將領陳泰權、天河縣主簿徐彌高諭和之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chunxi, Nandan was attacked by Yongle Prefecture. Envoys came to report the emergency, and the Guangxi commander dispatched generals Chen Taiquan and Tianhe County registrar Xu Migao to announce reconciliation.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 1 (1174) Nandan came under attack from Yongle Prefecture. Envoys arrived pleading for help, and the Guangxi commander sent generals Chen Taiquan and Tianhe County registrar Xu Migao to mediate.

sentences.zh: 十四年，經略司奏以延陰襲職，詔從其請。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the frontier commission memorialized that Yan Yin should succeed to the post, and an edict granted the request.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year (1187) the frontier commission recommended Yan Yin to succeed to the post, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 嘉定五年，延陰之子光熙襲職，知南丹州事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Jiading, Yan Yin’s son Guangxi succeeded to the post and was appointed to know the affairs of Nandan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiading 5 (1212) Yan Yin’s son Guangxi succeeded to the post as acting prefect of Nandan.
